member:GlobalBankingSegment.doc: Global Commercial Banking provides a wide range of lending-related products and services, integrated working capital management and treasury solutions to clients through the Corporations network of offices and client relationship teams along with various product partners. Clients include business banking and middle-market companies, commercial real estate firms and governments, and are generally defined as companies with sales up to $2 billion. Lending products and services include commercial loans and commitment facilities, real estate lending, asset-based lending and indirect consumer loans. Capital management and treasury solutions include treasury management, foreign exchange and short-term investing options.
member:GlobalBankingSegment.label: Global Banking Segment [Member]

member:GlobalMarketsSegment.doc: Global Markets provides financial products, advisory services, financing, securities clearing, settlement and custody services globally to institutional investor clients in support of their investing and trading activities. Global Markets also works with commercial and corporate clients to provide debt and equity underwriting and distribution capabilities, merger-related and other advisory services, and risk management products using interest rate, equity, credit, currency and commodity derivatives, foreign exchange, fixed-income and mortgage-related products. As a result of the Corporations market-making activities in these products, it may be required to manage positions in government securities, equity and equity-linked securities, high-grade and high-yield corporate debt securities, commercial paper, MBS and ABS. Corporate banking services provide a wide range of lending-related products and services, integrated working capital management and treasury solutions to clients through the Corporations network of offices and client relationship teams along with various product partners. Corporate clients are generally defined as companies with sales greater than $2 billion.
member:GlobalMarketsSegment.label: Global Markets Segment [Member]

member:GlobalWealthAndInvestmentManageme.doc: GWIM provides comprehensive wealth management capabilities to a broad base of clients from emerging affluent to the ultra-high-net-worth. These services include investment and brokerage services, estate and financial planning, fiduciary portfolio management, cash and liability management and specialty asset management. GWIM also provides retirement and benefit plan services, philanthropic management and asset management to individual and institutional clients. In addition, GWIM includes the results of BofA Capital Management, the cash and liquidity asset management business that the Corporation retained following the sale of the Columbia long-term asset management business, and other miscellaneous items. GWIM also reflects the impact of migrating clients and their related deposit and loan balances to or from GWIM and Deposits, Home Loans & Insurance and the Corporations ALM activities. Subsequent to the date of migration, the associated net interest income, noninterest income and noninterest expense are recorded in the business to which the clients migrated.
member:GlobalWealthAndInvestmentManageme.label: Global Wealth and Investment Management Segment [Member]

member:RefiningAndMarketing.doc: MPC's Refining and Marketing operating segment refines crude oil and other feedstocks at our refineries in the Gulf Coast and Midwest regions of the United States and distributes refined products through various means, including barges, terminals and trucks that we own or operate. axis:RegulatoryLiability.doc: Information by type of regulatory liability.
axis:RegulatoryLiability.label: Regulatory Liability [Axis]

axis:RelatedPartyTransaction.doc: Information by type of related party transaction.
axis:RelatedPartyTransaction.label: Related Party Transaction [Axis]

Related party includes, but is not limited to, affiliate, other entity for which investment is accounted for under equity method, trust for benefit of employee, principal owner, management, and member of immediate family, and other party that may be prevented from pursuing separate interests because of control, significant influence, or ownership interest.
axis:RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPa.label: Related and Nonrelated Parties [Axis]

axis:ReserveQuantitiesByTypeOfReserve.doc: Information by types of proved developed and undeveloped petroleum reserves.
axis:ReserveQuantitiesByTypeOfReserve.label: Petroleum Reserves [Axis]

axis:Restatement.doc: Information by adjustment to previously issued financial statements. Includes, but is not limited to, adjustment for retrospective application of amendment to accounting standards, other change in accounting principle, correction of error, and other revision.
axis:Restatement.label: Revision of Prior Period [Axis]

axis:RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsCas.doc: Information by category of cash or cash equivalent items which are restricted as to withdrawal or usage.
axis:RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsCas.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents [Axis]

axis:RestructuringCostAndReserve.doc: Information by type of restructuring cost.
axis:RestructuringCostAndReserve.label: Restructuring Type [Axis]

axis:RetirementPlanName.doc: Information by name of plan designed to provide retirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, legal name of defined benefit and defined contribution plans.
axis:RetirementPlanName.label: Retirement Plan Name [Axis]

axis:RetirementPlanSponsorLocation.doc: Information by location of employer sponsoring plan designed to provide retirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.
axis:RetirementPlanSponsorLocation.label: Retirement Plan Sponsor Location [Axis]

axis:RetirementPlanType.doc: Information by type of retirement benefit plan. Includes, but is not limited to, retirement benefit arrangement for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, retirement benefit arrangement for defined contribution pension and other postretirement plans, and special and contractual termination benefits payable upon retirement.
axis:RetirementPlanType.label: Retirement Plan Type [Axis]

axis:SaleLeasebackTransactionDescription.doc: Information by sale and leaseback transaction.
axis:SaleLeasebackTransactionDescription.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Description [Axis]

axis:Scenario.doc: Information by scenario reported, distinguishing information from actual fact. Includes, but is not limited to, pro forma and forecast. Excludes actual facts.
axis:Scenario.label: Scenario [Axis]

axis:ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEqu.doc: Information by name of investment including named security. Excludes entity that is consolidated.
axis:ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEqu.label: Investment, Name [Axis]

axis:SecurityOwnedAndSoldNotYetPurchased.doc: Information by financial instrument held by broker-dealer for its own account for trading or investment purposes and carried at fair value. Includes, but is not limited to, security sold, not yet purchased.
axis:SecurityOwnedAndSoldNotYetPurchased.label: Security Owned and Sold, Not yet Purchased, at Fair Value [Axis]

axis:SeparateAccountAssetCategory.doc: Information by separate account asset investment.
axis:SeparateAccountAssetCategory.label: Separate Account Asset Category [Axis]

axis:SfpLocationActivityCapitalization.doc: Information by location in statement of financial position line item where disaggregated capitalized activity is included.

axis:ShortTermDebtType.doc: Information by type of short-term debt arrangement.
axis:ShortTermDebtType.label: Short-Term Debt, Type [Axis]

axis:SubsegmentsConsolidationItems.doc: Information by subsegments, eliminations and reconciling items used in consolidating a reportable segment and its subsegments.
axis:SubsegmentsConsolidationItems.label: Subsegments Consolidation Items [Axis]

axis:SubsequentEventType.doc: Information by event that occurred after the balance sheet date but before financial statements are issued or available to be issued.
axis:SubsequentEventType.label: Subsequent Event Type [Axis]

axis:SubsidiarySaleOfStock.doc: Information by type of sale of the entity's stock.
axis:SubsidiarySaleOfStock.label: Sale of Stock [Axis]

axis:TimingOfTransferOfGoodOrService.doc: Information by timing of transfer of good or service to customer.
axis:TimingOfTransferOfGoodOrService.label: Timing of Transfer of Good or Service [Axis]

axis:TradingActivityByType.doc: Information by type of trading activity.
axis:TradingActivityByType.label: Trading Activity [Axis]

axis:TransactionType.doc: Information by type of agreement between buyer and seller for the exchange of financial instruments.
axis:TransactionType.label: Transaction Type [Axis]

axis:TypeOfArrangement.doc: Information by collaborative arrangement and arrangement other than collaborative applicable to revenue-generating activity or operations.
axis:TypeOfArrangement.label: Collaborative Arrangement and Arrangement Other than Collaborative [Axis]

axis:UnusualOrInfrequentItem.doc: Information by an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.
axis:UnusualOrInfrequentItem.label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both [Axis]

axis:ValuationAllowanceByDeferredTaxAsse.doc: Information by type of deferred tax consequences attributable to deductible temporary differences.
axis:ValuationAllowanceByDeferredTaxAsse.label: Valuation Allowance by Deferred Tax Asset [Axis]

axis:ValuationAllowancesAndReservesType.doc: Information by valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves.
axis:ValuationAllowancesAndReservesType.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves Type [Axis]

axis:ValuationTechnique.doc: Information by valuation approach and technique.
axis:ValuationTechnique.label: Valuation Approach and Technique [Axis]

member:AboveMarketLeases.doc: Leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at above market lease rate.
member:AboveMarketLeases.label: Above Market Leases [Member]

member:AccidentAndHealthInsuranceExcludi.doc: Contract providing insurance coverage against loss by illness or injury. Includes, but is not limited to, medical, dental, disability, and long-term care. Excludes workers' compensation.

member:AccidentAndHealthInsuranceSegment.doc: Product line consisting of insurance against loss by illness or injury, including but not limited to medical, dental, disability, workmen's compensation and long-term care.
member:AccidentAndHealthInsuranceSegment.label: Accident and Health Insurance Product Line [Member]

member:AccountingStandardsUpdate201613.doc: Accounting Standards Update 2016-13 Financial Instruments-Credit Losses (Topic 326): Measurement of Credit Losses on Financial Instruments.
member:AccountingStandardsUpdate201613.label: Accounting Standards Update 2016-13 [Member]

member:AccountsReceivable.doc: Due from customers or clients for goods or services that have been delivered or sold.
member:AccountsReceivable.label: Accounts Receivable [Member]

member:AccruedIncomeReceivable.doc: Fees and other revenue recorded based on estimates or specific contractual terms as transactions occur or services are rendered, provided that persuasive evidence exists, the price to the customer is fixed or determinable and collectability is reasonably assured, which have not yet been received as of the balance sheet date.
member:AccruedIncomeReceivable.label: Accrued Income Receivable [Member]

member:AccruedLiabilities.doc: This item represents obligations incurred and payable, pertaining to costs that are statutory in nature, are incurred on contractual obligations, or accumulate over time and for which invoices have not yet been received or will not be rendered.
member:AccruedLiabilities.label: Accrued Liabilities [Member]

member:AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdj.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss related to defined benefit plans attributable to the parent.
member:AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdj.label: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment Attributable to Parent [Member]

member:AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdj.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss related to defined benefit plans attributable to the noncontrolling interest.
member:AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdj.label: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]

member:AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdj.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss related to defined benefit plans including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.
member:AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdj.label: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]

member:AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdj.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) related to gain (loss) component of defined benefit plans including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.
member:AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdj.label: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment, Net Gain (Loss) Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]

member:AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdj.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss related to prior service cost (credit) component of defined benefit plans attributable to the parent.
member:AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdj.label: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment, Net Prior Service Attributable to Parent [Member]

member:AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdj.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss related to prior service cost (credit) component of defined benefit plans including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.
member:AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdj.label: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment, Net Prior Service Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]

member:AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdj.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) related to transition asset (obligation) component of defined benefit plans attributable to the parent.
member:AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdj.label: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment, Net Transition Attributable to Parent [Member]

member:AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdj.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) related to gain (loss) component of defined benefit plans attributable to the parent.
member:AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdj.label: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment, Net Gain (Loss) Attributable to Parent [Member]

member:AccumulatedDistributionsInExcessO.doc: Cumulative distributions to shareholders (or partners) in excess of retained earnings (or accumulated earnings).
member:AccumulatedDistributionsInExcessO.label: Accumulated Distributions in Excess of Net Income [Member]

member:AccumulatedForeignCurrencyAdjustm.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) resulting from foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to the noncontrolling interest.
member:AccumulatedForeignCurrencyAdjustm.label: Accumulated Foreign Currency Adjustment Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]

member:AccumulatedForeignCurrencyAdjustm.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) resulting from foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.
member:AccumulatedForeignCurrencyAdjustm.label: Accumulated Foreign Currency Adjustment Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]

member:AccumulatedGainLossCashFlowHedgeI.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) from gain (loss) of derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest.
member:AccumulatedGainLossCashFlowHedgeI.label: Accumulated Gain (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Including Noncontrolling Interest [Member]

member:AccumulatedGainLossFinancialLiabi.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option, attributable to noncontrolling interest.
member:AccumulatedGainLossFinancialLiabi.label: Accumulated Gain (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]

member:AccumulatedGainLossFinancialLiabi.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option, attributable to parent.
member:AccumulatedGainLossFinancialLiabi.label: Accumulated Gain (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, Attributable to Parent [Member]

member:AccumulatedGainLossFinancialLiabi.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option, including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest.
member:AccumulatedGainLossFinancialLiabi.label: Accumulated Gain (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]

member:AccumulatedGainLossNetCashFlowHed.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) from gain (loss) of derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to noncontrolling interest.
member:AccumulatedGainLossNetCashFlowHed.label: Accumulated Gain (Loss), Net, Cash Flow Hedge, Noncontrolling Interest [Member]

member:AccumulatedGainLossNetCashFlowHed.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) from gain (loss) of derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.
member:AccumulatedGainLossNetCashFlowHed.label: Accumulated Gain (Loss), Net, Cash Flow Hedge, Parent [Member]

member:AccumulatedNetInvestmentGainLossA.doc: Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to noncontrolling interest.
member:AccumulatedNetInvestmentGainLossA.label: AOCI, Accumulated Gain (Loss), Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Noncontrolling Interest [Member]

member:AccumulatedNetInvestmentGainLossI.doc: Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest.
member:AccumulatedNetInvestmentGainLossI.label: AOCI, Accumulated Gain (Loss), Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Including Noncontrolling Interest [Member]

member:AccumulatedNetUnrealizedInvestmen.doc: Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.
member:AccumulatedNetUnrealizedInvestmen.label: AOCI, Accumulated Gain (Loss), Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Parent [Member]

member:AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveInco.doc: Accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, attributable to the parent. Excludes net income (loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.
member:AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveInco.label: AOCI Attributable to Parent [Member]

member:AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveInco.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative hedge, including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest.
member:AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveInco.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative Qualifying as Hedge, Excluded Component, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]

member:AccumulatedTranslationAdjustment.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) resulting from foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to the parent.
member:AccumulatedTranslationAdjustment.label: Accumulated Foreign Currency Adjustment Attributable to Parent [Member]

member:AdditionalFundingAgreementTerms.doc: Terms of commitments to provide additional funding under research and development arrangements accounted for as a contract to perform research and development for others.
member:AdditionalFundingAgreementTerms.label: Additional Funding Agreement Terms [Member]

member:AdditionalPaidInCapital.doc: Excess of issue price over par or stated value of the entity's capital stock and amounts received from other transactions involving the entity's stock or stockholders.
member:AdditionalPaidInCapital.label: Additional Paid-in Capital [Member]

member:Admission.doc: Right or permission to enter. Includes, but is not limited to, entrance to park, ride, attraction, theater, sporting event, and movie.
member:Admission.label: Admission [Member]

member:Advertising.doc: Announcement promoting product, service, or event.
member:Advertising.label: Advertising [Member]

member:AffiliatedEntity.doc: An affiliate is a party that, directly or indirectly through one or more intermediaries, controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with the entity.
member:AffiliatedEntity.label: Affiliated Entity [Member]

member:AgencySecurities.doc: Securities issued by government sponsored entities.
member:AgencySecurities.label: Agency Securities [Member]

member:AllOtherCorporateBonds.doc: Investments in corporate fixed maturity debt securities classified as other.

member:AllOtherSegments.doc: Operating segments classified as other. Excludes intersegment elimination and reconciling items.
member:AllOtherSegments.label: Other Operating Segment [Member]

member:AllowanceForCreditLoss.doc: Allowance for credit loss from right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.
member:AllowanceForCreditLoss.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Allowance, Credit Loss [Member]

member:AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLosses.doc: Allowance for portion expected to be uncollectible of receivable from loan and lease portfolio.
member:AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLosses.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Allowance, Loan and Lease Loss [Member]

member:AlternativeEnergy.doc: Power generated from source other than fossil fuel. Source includes, but is not limited to, ethanol, biomass, solar, geothermal, and wind power.
member:AlternativeEnergy.label: Alternative Energy [Member]

member:Americas.doc: Continents of North and South America.
member:Americas.label: Americas [Member]

member:AociAttributableToNoncontrollingI.doc: Accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Excludes net income (loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.
member:AociAttributableToNoncontrollingI.label: AOCI Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]

member:AociDerivativeQualifyingAsHedgeEx.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative hedge, attributable to noncontrolling interest.
member:AociDerivativeQualifyingAsHedgeEx.label: AOCI, Derivative Qualifying as Hedge, Excluded Component, Noncontrolling Interest [Member]

member:AociDerivativeQualifyingAsHedgeEx.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative hedge, attributable to parent.
member:AociDerivativeQualifyingAsHedgeEx.label: AOCI, Derivative Qualifying as Hedge, Excluded Component, Parent [Member]

member:AociEquityMethodInvestmentParent.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from proportionate share of equity method investee's other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI), attributable to parent.
member:AociEquityMethodInvestmentParent.label: AOCI, Equity Method Investment, Parent [Member]

member:AociGainLossDebtSecuritiesAvailab.doc: Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with allowance for credit loss, including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest.

Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with allowance for credit loss, attributable to parent.
member:AociGainLossDebtSecuritiesAvailab.label: AOCI, Gain (Loss), Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, with Allowance for Credit Loss, Parent [Member]

member:AociGainLossDebtSecuritiesAvailab.doc: Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), without allowance for credit loss, including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest.

Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), without allowance for credit loss, attributable to parent.
member:AociGainLossDebtSecuritiesAvailab.label: AOCI, Gain (Loss), Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, without Allowance for Credit Loss, Parent [Member]

member:AociIncludingPortionAttributableT.doc: Accumulated change in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Excludes net income (loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.
member:AociIncludingPortionAttributableT.label: AOCI Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]

member:AociLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenef.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate, including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest.
Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate, attributable to noncontrolling interest.
Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate, attributable to parent.

member:AociMarketRiskBenefitInstrumentSp.doc: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity protecting contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposing insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk, including attributable to noncontrolling interest.

Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity protecting contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposing insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity protecting contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposing insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk, attributable to parent.

member:ApartmentBuilding.doc: Building containing a number of residential apartments.
member:ApartmentBuilding.label: Apartment Building [Member]

member:AssetBackedSecurities.doc: Securities that are primarily serviced by the cash flows of a discrete pool of receivables or other financial assets for example, but not limited to, credit card receivables, car loans, recreational vehicle loans, and mobile home loans.
member:AssetBackedSecurities.label: Asset-Backed Securities [Member]

member:AssetBackedSecuritiesSecuritizedL.doc: Securities that are primarily serviced with cash flows derived financial assets that are being securitized for example, but not limited to, credit card receivables, car loans, recreational vehicle loans, and mobile home loans. Excludes mortgage-backed securities.
member:AssetBackedSecuritiesSecuritizedL.label: Asset-Backed Securities, Securitized Loans and Receivables [Member]

member:AssetManagement1.doc: Management of investment fund portfolio. Excludes investment advisory, distribution and servicing, and performance fee.
member:AssetManagement1.label: Asset Management [Member]

member:AssetNotPledgedAsCollateralAndAss.doc: Asset not pledged as collateral and asset pledged as collateral for which secured party (transferee) does not have right to sell or repledge by contract or custom.
member:AssetNotPledgedAsCollateralAndAss.label: Asset Not Pledged as Collateral and Asset Pledged as Collateral without Right [Member]

member:AssetPledgedAsCollateralWithRight.doc: Asset pledged as collateral for which secured party (transferee) has right to sell or repledge by contract or custom.
member:AssetPledgedAsCollateralWithRight.label: Asset Pledged as Collateral with Right [Member]

member:AssetPledgedAsCollateralWithoutRi.doc: Asset pledged as collateral for which secured party (transferee) does not have right to sell or repledge by contract or custom.
member:AssetPledgedAsCollateralWithoutRi.label: Asset Pledged as Collateral without Right [Member]

member:AssetRecoverableGasCosts.doc: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of gas costs.

member:AssetRetirementObligationCosts.doc: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of costs for the retirement of long-lived assets.
member:AssetRetirementObligationCosts.label: Asset Retirement Obligation Costs [Member]

member:AssetUnderConstruction.doc: Asset in process of being built.
member:AssetUnderConstruction.label: Asset under Construction [Member]

member:Assets.doc: Asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.
member:Assets.label: Assets [Member]

member:AssetsHeldUnderCapitalLeases.doc: Long lived property, plant or equipment assets held by a lessee through a capital lease arrangement.
member:AssetsHeldUnderCapitalLeases.label: Assets Held under Capital Leases [Member]

member:AssetsTotal.doc: Total assets, when it serves as a benchmark in a concentration of risk calculation, representing the sum of all reported assets as of the balance sheet date.
member:AssetsTotal.label: Assets, Total [Member]

member:AtlanticDestination.doc: Atlantic destinations determined principally based on geographic region as defined by the U.S. Department of Transportation.

member:AutomobileLoan.doc: Loan to finance the purchase of a vehicle.
member:AutomobileLoan.label: Automobile Loan [Member]

member:Automobiles.doc: Vehicles that are used primarily for transporting people.
member:Automobiles.label: Automobiles [Member]

member:AutomotiveSector.doc: Sector of economy consisting of companies engaged in business activity related to motor vehicle.
member:AutomotiveSector.label: Automotive Sector [Member]

member:AvailableforsaleSecurities.doc: Investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).
member:AvailableforsaleSecurities.label: Available-for-Sale Securities [Member]

member:BalancedFunds.doc: Regulated investment instrument that pools funds from multiple investors to invest principally in a portfolio of securities and money market instruments to match a moderate investment objective.

member:BankLoanObligations.doc: Investments in debentures, bonds and other debt securities issued by a bank holding company, its subsidiaries, or affiliates.
member:BankLoanObligations.label: Bank Loan Obligations [Member]

member:BankOverdrafts.doc: Excess drawing from an existing cash balance that is honored by the bank but is owed to the bank.
member:BankOverdrafts.label: Bank Overdrafts [Member]

member:BankServicing.doc: Collection and processing of payment on mortgage, credit card and other financial asset held by others.
member:BankServicing.label: Bank Servicing [Member]

member:BankTimeDeposits.doc: Certificates of deposit (CD) or savings accounts with a fixed term or understanding the customer can only withdraw by giving advanced notice with a bank or other financial institution. A CD is a short to medium-term investment available at banks and savings and loan institutions where a customer agrees to lend money to the institution for a certain amount of time and is paid a predetermined rate of interest.
member:BankTimeDeposits.label: Bank Time Deposits [Member]

member:Banking.doc: Financial institution accepting customer deposits and providing other financial services. Services include, but are not limited to, lending; issuing credit and debit cards; offering deposit account, mortgage, and guarantee; and bank servicing.
member:Banking.label: Banking [Member]

member:BanksTrustAndInsuranceEquities.doc: This item represents investments by the reporting entity in equity securities issued by a bank, a trust or an insurance company.

member:BilledRevenues.doc: Billed amounts due for services rendered or products shipped. This element is distinct from Billed contracts receivables because this is based on noncontract transactions.
member:BilledRevenues.label: Billed Revenues [Member]

member:Bonds.doc: Debt security, in which the authorized issuer owes the holder a debt and is obliged to repay the principal and interest (the coupon).
member:Bonds.label: Bonds [Member]

member:Building.doc: Facility held for productive use including, but not limited to, office, production, storage and distribution facilities.
member:Building.label: Building [Member]

member:BuildingAndBuildingImprovements.doc: Facility held for productive use including, but not limited to, office, production, storage and distribution facilities and any addition, improvement, or renovation to the structure, for example, but not limited to, interior masonry, interior flooring, electrical, and plumbing.
member:BuildingAndBuildingImprovements.label: Building and Building Improvements [Member]

member:BuildingImprovements.doc: Addition, improvement, or renovation to a facility held for productive use including, but not limited to, office, production, storage and distribution facilities.
member:BuildingImprovements.label: Building Improvements [Member]

member:CapitalUnits.doc: Type of ownership interest in a corporation. Class of capital units or capital shares.
member:CapitalUnits.label: Capital Units [Member]

member:CarryingReportedAmountFairValueDi.doc: Measured as reported on the statement of financial position (balance sheet).
member:CarryingReportedAmountFairValueDi.label: Reported Value Measurement [Member]

member:Cash.doc: Currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits.
member:Cash.label: Cash [Member]

member:CashAndCashEquivalents.doc: Currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.
member:CashAndCashEquivalents.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents [Member]

member:CashEquivalents.doc: Short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.
member:CashEquivalents.label: Cash Equivalents [Member]

member:CashFlowHedging.doc: Hedge of the exposure to variability in the cash flows of a recognized asset or liability, or of a forecasted transaction, that is attributable to a particular risk.
member:CashFlowHedging.label: Cash Flow Hedging [Member]

member:Catastrophe.doc: Natural event resulting in great loss.
member:Catastrophe.label: Catastrophe [Member]

member:CertificatesOfDeposit.doc: Short to medium-term investment available at banks and savings and loan institutions where a customer agrees to lend money to the institution for a certain amount of time and is paid a predetermined rate of interest. Certificates of deposit (CD) are typically Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insured.
member:CertificatesOfDeposit.label: Certificates of Deposit [Member]

member:ChangeDuringPeriodFairValueDisclo.doc: Measure of change in fair value.
member:ChangeDuringPeriodFairValueDisclo.label: Changes Measurement [Member]

member:ChemicalsSector.doc: Sector of economy consisting of companies engaged in business activity related to chemicals.
member:ChemicalsSector.label: Chemicals Sector [Member]

member:CollaborativeArrangement.doc: Contractual arrangement that involves two or more parties that both: (i) actively participate in a joint operating activity and (ii) are exposed to significant risks and rewards that depend on the commercial success of the joint operating activity.
member:CollaborativeArrangement.label: Collaborative Arrangement [Member]

member:CollaborativeArrangementTransacti.doc: Collaborative arrangement transaction between parties to collaborative arrangement.
member:CollaborativeArrangementTransacti.label: Collaborative Arrangement, Transaction with Party to Collaborative Arrangement [Member]

member:CollateralPledged.doc: Pledge of specific property to serve as protection against default.
member:CollateralPledged.label: Collateral Pledged [Member]

member:CollateralizedAutoLoans.doc: Securities collateralized by a pool of auto loans.

member:CollateralizedCreditCardSecuritie.doc: Securities collateralized by a pool of credit card receivables.
member:CollateralizedCreditCardSecuritie.label: Collateralized Credit Card Securities [Member]

member:CollateralizedDebtObligations.doc: Securities collateralized by a pool of assets.
member:CollateralizedDebtObligations.label: Collateralized Debt Obligations [Member]

member:CollateralizedLoanObligations.doc: Securities collateralized by a pool of loans.
member:CollateralizedLoanObligations.label: Collateralized Loan Obligations [Member]

member:CollateralizedMortgageObligations.doc: The category includes multiclass, pay-through securitizations collateralized by mortgages secured by assets, such as automobiles and boats, which are generally structured so that the collections of principal and interest due from the underlying debtors are paid to the holders of the CMO.
member:CollateralizedMortgageObligations.label: Collateralized Mortgage Obligations [Member]

member:CollateralizedSecurities.doc: Securities collateralized by other financial instruments or pools of financial instruments.
member:CollateralizedSecurities.label: Collateralized Securities [Member]

member:CommercialAndIndustrialSector.doc: Sector of the economy consisting of companies engaged in commercial and industrial business activities.
member:CommercialAndIndustrialSector.label: Commercial and Industrial Sector [Member]

member:CommercialLoan.doc: A loan, whether secured or unsecured, to a company for purposes such as seasonal working capital needs, inventory financing, equipment purchases and acquisitions.
member:CommercialLoan.label: Commercial Loan [Member]

member:CommercialMortgageBackedSecuritie.doc: Securities collateralized by commercial real estate mortgage loans.
member:CommercialMortgageBackedSecuritie.label: Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities [Member]

member:CommercialPaper.doc: Unsecured promissory note (generally negotiable) that provides institutions with short-term funds.
member:CommercialPaper.label: Commercial Paper [Member]

member:CommercialPaperNotIncludedWithCas.doc: Unsecured promissory note (generally negotiable) that provides institutions with short-term funds that is excluded from cash and cash equivalents.
member:CommercialPaperNotIncludedWithCas.label: Commercial Paper, Not Included with Cash and Cash Equivalents [Member]

member:CommercialPortfolioSegment.doc: Portfolio segment of the company's total financing receivables related to commercial receivables.
member:CommercialPortfolioSegment.label: Commercial Portfolio Segment [Member]

member:CommercialRealEstate.doc: Property that is solely used for business purposes.
member:CommercialRealEstate.label: Commercial Real Estate [Member]

member:CommercialRealEstatePortfolioSegm.doc: Portfolio segment of the company's total financing receivables related to commercial real estate.
member:CommercialRealEstatePortfolioSegm.label: Commercial Real Estate Portfolio Segment [Member]

member:CommitmentsToExtendCredit.doc: Loan commitments are legally binding commitments to extend credit to a counterparty under certain terms and conditions.
member:CommitmentsToExtendCredit.label: Commitments to Extend Credit [Member]

member:CommoditiesInvestment.doc: Investments held in a physical substance, such as food, grains, and metals, which is interchangeable with another product of the same type, and which investors buy or sell, usually through futures contracts.

member:CommodityContract.doc: Derivative instrument whose primary underlying risk is tied to commodity prices.
member:CommodityContract.label: Commodity Contract [Member]

member:CommonClassA.doc: Classification of common stock representing ownership interest in a corporation.
member:CommonClassA.label: Common Class A [Member]

member:CommonClassB.doc: Classification of common stock that has different rights than Common Class A, representing ownership interest in a corporation.
member:CommonClassB.label: Common Class B [Member]

member:CommonClassC.doc: Classification of common stock that has different rights than provided to Class A or B shares, representing ownership interest in a corporation.
member:CommonClassC.label: Common Class C [Member]

member:CommonStock.doc: Stock that is subordinate to all other stock of the issuer.
member:CommonStock.label: Common Stock [Member]

member:CommonStockIncludingAdditionalPai.doc: Common stock held by shareholders with par value plus amounts in excess of par value or issuance value (in cases of no-par value stock).
member:CommonStockIncludingAdditionalPai.label: Common Stock Including Additional Paid in Capital [Member]

member:ComputerEquipment.doc: Long lived, depreciable assets that are used in the creation, maintenance and utilization of information systems.
member:ComputerEquipment.label: Computer Equipment [Member]

member:ConsolidatedEntities.doc: Entities which have been consolidated for financial statement presentation purposes.
member:ConsolidatedEntities.label: Consolidated Entities [Member]

member:ConsolidatedEntityExcludingVariab.doc: Consolidated entity excluding consolidated variable interest entity (VIE) for which reporting entity is primary beneficiary.
member:ConsolidatedEntityExcludingVariab.label: Consolidated Entity, Excluding Consolidated VIE [Member]

member:ConsolidatedEntityExcludingVie.doc: Consolidated entity, excluding variable interest entity (VIE) for which reporting entity is or is not primary beneficiary.
member:ConsolidatedEntityExcludingVie.label: Consolidated Entity, Excluding VIE [Member]

member:ConsolidationEliminations.doc: Eliminating entries used in consolidating a parent entity and its subsidiaries.
member:ConsolidationEliminations.label: Consolidation, Eliminations [Member]

member:Construction.doc: Building or developing real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, improvement to land for drainage, utilities, grading and subdividing.
member:Construction.label: Construction [Member]

member:ConstructionInProgress.doc: Structure or a modification to a structure under construction. Includes recently completed structures or modifications to structures that have not been placed into service.
member:ConstructionInProgress.label: Construction in Progress [Member]

member:ConstructionLoans.doc: A borrowing arrangement which provides the entity constructing a facility (such as a building and a landfill) with funds to effect construction, generally on a draw down, or as needed, basis.
member:ConstructionLoans.label: Construction Loans [Member]

member:ConsumerLoan.doc: Loan or extension of credit for personal, family, or household use excluding real estate.
member:ConsumerLoan.label: Consumer Loan [Member]

member:ConsumerOther.doc: Loan made to consumer, classified as other.
member:ConsumerOther.label: Consumer, Other [Member]

member:ConsumerPortfolioSegment.doc: Portfolio segment of the company's total financing receivables related to consumer receivables.
member:ConsumerPortfolioSegment.label: Consumer Portfolio Segment [Member]

member:ConsumerSector.doc: Sector of economy consisting of companies engaged in business activity related to consumer product and service.
member:ConsumerSector.label: Consumer Sector [Member]

member:ContainerAndPackagingSector.doc: Sector of economy consisting of companies engaged in business activity related to container and packaging.
member:ContainerAndPackagingSector.label: Container and Packaging Sector [Member]

member:ContractTermination.doc: Termination of a contract associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructurings pursuant to a plan.
member:ContractTermination.label: Contract Termination [Member]

member:ContractsAccountedForUnderPercent.doc: Modifications to or changes in assumptions surrounding contracts accounted for under the percentage of completion method of accounting. Percentage of completion is a method of accounting whereby profit on a long-term (construction) contracts is recognized based on reliable estimates as to the degree of completion generally based on contractual relationships (costs incurred to total costs anticipated).
member:ContractsAccountedForUnderPercent.label: Contracts Accounted for under Percentage of Completion [Member]

member:ContractualInterestRateReduction.doc: Loan modification for a reduction of contractual interest rate.
member:ContractualInterestRateReduction.label: Contractual Interest Rate Reduction [Member]

member:ContractualRights.doc: Rights that arise from a contractual arrangement with a third party (not including franchise rights and license agreements).
member:ContractualRights.label: Contractual Rights [Member]

member:ConventionalLoan.doc: Mortgage loan issued by a bank, which is typically in an amount between 70 to 80 percent of the purchase price of the property securing the loan, has a repayment period of 15 to 30 years, and requires that certain credit criteria be met.
member:ConventionalLoan.label: Conventional Mortgage Loan [Member]

member:ConvertibleDebt.doc: Borrowing which can be exchanged for a specified number of another security at the option of the issuer or the holder, for example, but not limited to, the entity's common stock.
member:ConvertibleDebt.label: Convertible Debt [Member]

member:ConvertiblePreferredStock.doc: Preferred stock that may be exchanged into common shares or other types of securities at the owner's option.
member:ConvertiblePreferredStock.label: Convertible Preferred Stock [Member]

member:CoreDeposits.doc: Entity's long-term relationships with depositors, commonly known as core deposit intangibles, which are separate from the financial instruments themselves.
member:CoreDeposits.label: Core Deposits [Member]

member:Corporate.doc: Component of an entity that usually provides financial, operational and administrative support and is considered an operating segment. Excludes intersegment elimination and reconciling items.
member:Corporate.label: Corporate Segment [Member]

member:CorporateAndOther.doc: Component of entity providing financial and operational oversight and administrative support considered to be operating segment and operating segment, classified as other. Excludes intersegment elimination and reconciling item.
member:CorporateAndOther.label: Corporate Segment and Other Operating Segment [Member]

member:CorporateBondSecurities.doc: This category includes information about long-term debt securities that are issued by either a domestic or foreign corporate business entity with a date certain promise of repayment and a return to the holder for the time value of money (for example, variable or fixed interest, original issue discount).
member:CorporateBondSecurities.label: Corporate Bond Securities [Member]

member:CorporateDebtSecurities.doc: Debt securities issued by domestic or foreign corporate business, banks and other entities with a promise of repayment.
member:CorporateDebtSecurities.label: Corporate Debt Securities [Member]

member:CorporateJointVenture.doc: Corporation owned and operated by a small group of ventures to accomplish a mutually beneficial venture or project.
member:CorporateJointVenture.label: Corporate Joint Venture [Member]

member:CorporateNonSegment.doc: Corporate headquarters or functional department that may not earn revenues or may earn revenues that are only incidental to the activities of the entity and is not considered an operating segment.
member:CorporateNonSegment.label: Segment Reporting, Reconciling Item, Corporate Nonsegment [Member]

member:CorporateNoteSecurities.doc: This category includes information about short-term debt securities that are issued by either a domestic or foreign corporate business entity with a date certain promise of repayment and a return to the holder for the time value of money (for example, variable or fixed interest).
member:CorporateNoteSecurities.label: Corporate Note Securities [Member]

member:CostApproachValuationTechnique.doc: Valuation approach reflecting amount that would be required currently to replace service capacity of asset.
member:CostApproachValuationTechnique.label: Valuation, Cost Approach [Member]

member:Credit.doc: Trading in a derivative instrument whose primary underlying risk is tied to the creditworthiness or the credit spread of an entity.
member:Credit.label: Credit [Member]

member:CreditAndDebitCard.doc: Card issued to user to facilitate payment for purchase of product and service paid directly to merchant by issuer, or from user's checking account.
member:CreditAndDebitCard.label: Credit and Debit Card [Member]

member:CreditCard.doc: Card issued to user to facilitate payment for purchase of product and service, paid directly to merchant by card issuer, and later paid by cardholder to card issuer.
member:CreditCard.label: Credit Card [Member]

member:CreditCardMerchantDiscount.doc: Charge to merchant for cardholder's use of credit card. Excludes interest income earned on credit card balance, transaction and credit card service.
member:CreditCardMerchantDiscount.label: Credit Card, Merchant Discount [Member]

member:CreditCardReceivables.doc: Receivable from card issued to user to facilitate payment for purchase of product or service or both paid directly to merchant by card issuer, and later paid by cardholder to card issuer.
member:CreditCardReceivables.label: Credit Card Receivable [Member]

member:CreditConcentrationRisk.doc: Reflects the percentage that a specified receivable or amount at risk from a counterparty under a contractual arrangement is to a specified benchmark, such as total receivables, net revenues, pretax results. Risk is the materially adverse effects of loss attributable to (a) the failure to collect a significant receivable from a major customer or group of homogeneous accounts, or (b) a failure by a counterparty to perform under terms of a contractual arrangement.
member:CreditConcentrationRisk.label: Credit Concentration Risk [Member]

member:CreditDefaultOption.doc: A contract in which one party has the right to claim a payment from another party in the event that a specified credit event occurs over the life of the contract. Also known as credit default agreements.

member:CreditDefaultSwap.doc: Credit derivative contract between credit default swap buyer and third party in which credit default swap buyer makes periodic payment to third party and third party guarantees to reimburse credit default swap buyer if original borrower defaults.
member:CreditDefaultSwap.label: Credit Default Swap [Member]

member:CreditDefaultSwapBuyingProtection.doc: Credit derivative contract between credit default swap buyer and third party in which periodic payment is made to third party and third party guarantees to reimburse if original borrower defaults.
member:CreditDefaultSwapBuyingProtection.label: Credit Default Swap, Buying Protection [Member]

member:CreditDefaultSwapSellingProtectio.doc: Credit derivative contract between credit default swap buyer and third party in which periodic payment is received from credit default swap buyer and guarantee is made to reimburse credit default swap buyer if original borrower defaults.
member:CreditDefaultSwapSellingProtectio.label: Credit Default Swap, Selling Protection [Member]

member:CreditIndexProduct.doc: A credit derivative with an underlying related to an index based on the credit risk of a group of entities.

member:CreditRiskContract.doc: Derivative instrument whose primary underlying risk is tied to the creditworthiness or the credit spread of an entity.
member:CreditRiskContract.label: Credit Risk Contract [Member]

member:Criticized.doc: Credit rating classification which identifies weaknesses related to credit risk. Includes, but is not limited to, special mention, substandard and doubtful classifications. Excludes noncriticized classification.
member:Criticized.label: Criticized [Member]

member:CrossCurrencyInterestRateContract.doc: Derivative instrument whose primary underlying risk is tied to interest rates and foreign exchange rates.
member:CrossCurrencyInterestRateContract.label: Cross Currency Interest Rate Contract [Member]

member:CrudeOil.doc: Unrefined, unprocessed oil, which may be used in a variety of applications, and from which, petroleum-based products are produced.
member:CrudeOil.label: Crude Oil [Member]

member:CumulativeEffectPeriodOfAdoptionA.doc: Represents amount after cumulative-effect adjustment to financial statement in period of adoption of amendment to accounting standards or from change in accounting principle.
Increase (decrease) to financial statements for cumulative-effect adjustment in period of adoption of amendment to accounting standards.
member:CumulativeEffectPeriodOfAdoptionA.label: Cumulative Effect, Period of Adoption, Adjustment [Member]

member:CurrencySwap.doc: Swap involving the exchange of principal and interest in one currency for another currency.
member:CurrencySwap.label: Currency Swap [Member]

member:CustomerContracts.doc: Entity's established relationships with its customers through contracts.
member:CustomerContracts.label: Customer Contracts [Member]

member:CustomerLists.doc: Information about customers such as their name and contact information; it may also be an extensive database that includes other information about the customers such as their order history and demographic information.
member:CustomerLists.label: Customer Lists [Member]

member:CustomerRelatedIntangibleAssets.doc: Customer-related asset, including, but not limited to, customer lists, and noncontractual customer relationships.
member:CustomerRelatedIntangibleAssets.label: Customer-Related Intangible Assets [Member]

member:CustomerRelationships.doc: Customer relationship that exists between an entity and its customer, for example, but not limited to, tenant relationships.
member:CustomerRelationships.label: Customer Relationships [Member]

member:Debt.doc: Contractual obligation to pay money on demand or on fixed or determinable dates.
member:Debt.label: Debt [Member]

member:DebtSecurities.doc: Debt instrument issued by corporations, governments and governmental agencies, municipalities, and other institutions.
member:DebtSecurities.label: Debt Securities [Member]

member:DeferredCompensationShareBasedPay.doc: "Deferred compensation arrangements (such as stock or unit options and share or unit awards) that are equity-based payments with individual employees. The arrangements are generally based on employment contracts between the entity and one or more selected officers or key employees, and contain a promise by the employer to pay certain amounts or benefits at designated future dates, upon compliance with stipulated requirements. This type of arrangement is distinguished from broader based employee benefit plans as it is usually tailored to the employee. Other ""sub-members"" can be added as necessary."
member:DeferredCompensationShareBasedPay.label: Deferred Compensation, Share-Based Payments [Member]

member:DeferredDerivativeGainLoss.doc: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of gain (loss) on derivative contracts.
member:DeferredDerivativeGainLoss.label: Deferred Derivative Gain (Loss) [Member]

member:DeferredFixedAnnuity.doc: Contract that provides a guaranteed stream of fixed payments beginning at a future date.
member:DeferredFixedAnnuity.label: Deferred Fixed Annuity [Member]

member:DeferredFuelCosts.doc: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of fuel costs incurred.
member:DeferredFuelCosts.label: Deferred Fuel Costs [Member]

member:DeferredIncomeTaxCharges.doc: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of income taxes.
member:DeferredIncomeTaxCharges.label: Deferred Income Tax Charge [Member]

member:DeferredRevenueArrangementType.doc: Category of obligation arising when an entity receives consideration from a customer before achieving certain criteria that must be met for revenue to be recognized.
member:DeferredRevenueArrangementType.label: Deferred Revenue [Domain]

member:DeferredVariableAnnuity.doc: Contract that provides periodic payments, which vary according to the investment experience of the separate accounts in which the amounts paid to provide for the annuity are allocated, which begin at a future date.

member:DefinedBenefitPostretirementHealt.doc: Plan designed to provide postretirement health benefits to retiree or beneficiary. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.
member:DefinedBenefitPostretirementHealt.label: Postretirement Health Coverage [Member]

member:DepositAccount.doc: Bank account at depository institution allowing money to be withdrawn or deposited by account holder.
member:DepositAccount.label: Deposit Account [Member]

member:Deposits.doc: Amounts held on account by the entity representing a liability to the depositor. Deposits may take various forms (for example, demand deposits, saving deposits, Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW) and time deposits) and may be categorized in multiple ways (such as, foreign and domestic, interest and noninterest bearing).
member:Deposits.label: Deposits [Member]

member:Derivative.doc: This element represents types of derivative financial instruments which are financial instruments or other contractual arrangements with all three of the following characteristics: (a) it has (1) one or more underlyings and (2) one or more notional amounts or payment provisions or both. Those terms determine the amount of the settlement or settlements, and, in some cases, whether or not a settlement is required; (b) it requires no initial net investment or an initial net investment that is smaller than would be required for other types of contracts that would be expected to have a similar response to changes in market factors; and (c) its terms require or permit net settlement, it can readily be settled net by a means outside the contract, or it provides for delivery of an asset that puts the recipient in a position not substantially different from net settlement. Notwithstanding the above characteristics, loan commitments that relate to the origination of mortgage loans that will be held for sale are accounted for as derivative instruments by the issuer of the loan commitment (that is, the potential lender).
member:Derivative.label: Derivative [Member]

member:DerivativeFinancialInstrumentsAss.doc: Financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, with notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset.
member:DerivativeFinancialInstrumentsAss.label: Derivative Financial Instruments, Assets [Member]

member:DerivativeFinancialInstrumentsLia.doc: This item represents derivative instrument obligations meeting the definition of a liability which are reported as of the balance sheet date. Derivative instrument obligations are generally measured at fair value, and adjustments to the carrying amount of hedged items reflect changes in their fair value (that is, losses) that are attributable to the risk being hedged and that arise while the hedge is in effect.
member:DerivativeFinancialInstrumentsLia.label: Derivative Financial Instruments, Liabilities [Member]

member:DesignatedAsHedgingInstrument.doc: Derivative instrument designated as hedging instrument under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
member:DesignatedAsHedgingInstrument.label: Designated as Hedging Instrument [Member]

member:DevelopedTechnologyRights.doc: Rights to developed technology, which can include the right to develop, use, market, sell, or offer for sale products, compounds, or intellectual property.
member:DevelopedTechnologyRights.label: Developed Technology Rights [Member]

member:Director.doc: Person serving on board of directors.
member:Director.label: Director [Member]

member:DisabilityInsurancePolicy.doc: Contract that provides a benefit in the event the policyholder is incapable of working.

member:DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfB.doc: Component or group of components representing strategic shift that has or will have major effect on operation and financial result, disposed of in spinoff.
member:DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfB.label: Discontinued Operations, Disposed of by Means Other than Sale, Spinoff [Member]

member:DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfB.doc: Component or group of components representing strategic shift that has or will have major effect on operation and financial result, disposed of by sale.
member:DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfB.label: Discontinued Operations, Disposed of by Sale [Member]

member:DiscontinuedOperationsHeldforsale.doc: Component or group of components representing strategic shift that has or will have major effect on operation and financial result and business and nonprofit activity on acquisition and upon joint venture formation, classified as held-for-sale.
member:DiscontinuedOperationsHeldforsale.label: Discontinued Operations, Held-for-Sale [Member]

member:DisposalGroupDisposedOfByMeansOth.doc: Disposal group that is disposed of in a spinoff. Excludes disposals classified as discontinued operations.
member:DisposalGroupDisposedOfByMeansOth.label: Disposal Group, Disposed of by Means Other than Sale, Not Discontinued Operations, Spinoff [Member]

member:DisposalGroupDisposedOfBySaleNotD.doc: Disposal group that has been sold. Excludes disposals classified as discontinued operations.
member:DisposalGroupDisposedOfBySaleNotD.label: Disposal Group, Disposed of by Sale, Not Discontinued Operations [Member]

member:DisposalGroupHeldForSaleOrDispose.doc: Disposal group that either has been sold or is classified as held-for-sale. Excludes disposals classified as discontinued operations.
member:DisposalGroupHeldForSaleOrDispose.label: Disposal Group, Held-for-Sale or Disposed of by Sale, Not Discontinued Operations [Member]

member:DisposalGroupHeldforsaleNotDiscon.doc: Disposal group that is classified as held-for-sale. Excludes disposals classified as discontinued operations.
member:DisposalGroupHeldforsaleNotDiscon.label: Disposal Group, Held-for-Sale, Not Discontinued Operations [Member]

member:DistributionAndShareholderService.doc: Distribution and shareholder assistance. Distribution assistance includes, but is not limited to, marketing and selling fund shares, advertising, printing and mailing of prospectus and sale literature to investor. Shareholder assistance includes, but is not limited to, answering shareholder inquiry and providing shareholder with investment information.
member:DistributionAndShareholderService.label: Distribution and Shareholder Service [Member]

member:DistributionService.doc: Distribution assistance, including, but not limited to, marketing and selling fund shares, advertising, printing and mailing of prospectus and sale literature to investor.
member:DistributionService.label: Distribution Service [Member]

member:DomesticCorporateDebtSecurities.doc: Debt security issued by corporation domiciled in United States of America (US).
member:DomesticCorporateDebtSecurities.label: Debt Security, Corporate, US [Member]

member:DomesticDestination.doc: Domestic destinations determined principally based on geographic region as defined by the U.S. Department of Transportation.

member:Doubtful.doc: A category of financing receivables that have all the weaknesses inherent in those classified as substandard, with the added characteristic that the weaknesses make collection or liquidation in full, on the basis of currently existing facts, conditions, and values, highly questionable and improbable.
member:Doubtful.label: Doubtful [Member]

member:EMEA.doc: Regions of Europe, Middle East and Africa.
member:EMEA.label: EMEA [Member]

member:ElectricDistribution.doc: System used for the primary purpose of distributing electricity to the consumer.

member:ElectricTransmission.doc: System used for the electrical transmission of the bulk transport of high voltage power, typically over longer distances, between generating plants and distribution systems. Typically comprised of towers, overhead conductors, underground conduits, roads and trails.

member:Electricity.doc: Generation, transmission and distribution of electric energy.
member:Electricity.label: Electricity [Member]

member:ElectricityGeneration.doc: Process of producing electric energy by transforming other forms of energy, including, but not limited to, nuclear, fossil fuel, solar, geothermal, hydro and wind.

member:ElectricityPurchased.doc: Electric energy purchased from another party.
member:ElectricityPurchased.label: Electricity, Purchased [Member]

member:ElectricityUsRegulated.doc: Generation, transmission and distribution of electric energy regulated by government or agency in United States (US).
member:ElectricityUsRegulated.label: Electricity, US Regulated [Member]

member:EmbeddedDerivativeFinancialInstru.doc: Derivative instrument embedded in host contract.
member:EmbeddedDerivativeFinancialInstru.label: Embedded Derivative Financial Instruments [Member]

member:EmployeeSeverance.doc: Termination of an employee associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructurings pursuant to a plan.
member:EmployeeSeverance.label: Employee Severance [Member]

member:EmployeeStock.doc: An Employee Stock Purchase Plan is a tax-efficient means by which employees of a corporation can purchase the corporation's stock.
member:EmployeeStock.label: Employee Stock [Member]

member:EmployeeStockOption.doc: Share-based payment arrangement granting right, subject to vesting and other restrictions, to purchase or sell certain number of shares at predetermined price for specified period of time.
member:EmployeeStockOption.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Option [Member]

member:EnergyCommoditiesAndService.doc: Energy provided from operation of on-site facility or cogeneration plant and by procurement service to energy purchaser, and marketing and trading of energy commodity and derivative.
member:EnergyCommoditiesAndService.label: Energy Commodities and Service [Member]

member:EnergyRelatedDerivative.doc: Derivative instrument whose primary underlying risk is tied to energy, for example, but not limited to, crude oil, electricity and natural gas.
member:EnergyRelatedDerivative.label: Energy Related Derivative [Member]

member:EnergyService.doc: Energy provided from operation of on-site facility or cogeneration plant and by procurement service to energy purchaser.
member:EnergyService.label: Energy Service [Member]

member:EnhancedEquipmentTrustCertificate.doc: A debt security that is separated into two or more distinct debt instruments, each with unique terms, issued by separate trusts that purchase equipment that is then leased to the entity. The revenue stream of the leased asset services the debt. When the trusts retire or otherwise satisfy the certificates, title to the asset will generally pass to the lessee. This form of financing, for example, is commonly used by, but not limited to, airlines and railroads for the purchase of aircraft or rolling stock, respectively.

member:EntertainmentSector.doc: Sector of economy consisting of companies engaged in business activity related to entertainment.
member:EntertainmentSector.label: Entertainment Sector [Member]

member:EnvironmentalIssue.doc: Ecological or external issues that require remediation including, but not limited to, restoration or clean up of property, regulatory compliance, or to sell, abandon or dispose of such property.
member:EnvironmentalIssue.label: Environmental Issue [Member]

member:EnvironmentalRemediation.doc: Removal of contaminant from environmental media including, but not limited to, soil, groundwater, sediment and surface water.

member:EnvironmentalRestorationCosts.doc: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of costs associated with site remediation or other environmental exit costs that may occur on the sale, disposal, abandonment or decommissioning of a property.
member:EnvironmentalRestorationCosts.label: Environmental Restoration Costs [Member]

member:Equipment.doc: Tangible personal property used to produce goods and services.
member:Equipment.label: Equipment [Member]

member:Equity.doc: Trading in a derivative instrument whose primary underlying risk is tied to share prices.
member:Equity.label: Equity [Member]

member:EquityContract.doc: Derivative instrument whose primary underlying risk is tied to share prices.
member:EquityContract.label: Equity Contract [Member]

member:EquityFunds.doc: An investment that pools funds from many investors to invest in a combination of underlying investments, primarily equity investments.
member:EquityFunds.label: Equity Funds [Member]

member:EquityMethodInvestee.doc: An entity that issued voting stock held by an investor and that is accounted for under the equity method of accounting by the investor.
member:EquityMethodInvestee.label: Equity Method Investee [Member]

member:EquityMethodInvestmentNonconsolid.doc: Nonconsolidated equity method investee or group of nonconsolidated investees. Excludes information consolidated by reporting entity.
member:EquityMethodInvestmentNonconsolid.label: Equity Method Investment, Nonconsolidated Investee or Group of Investees [Member]

member:EquityMethodInvestmentNonconsolid.doc: Nonconsolidated equity method investee classified as other. Excludes information consolidated by reporting entity.
member:EquityMethodInvestmentNonconsolid.label: Equity Method Investment, Nonconsolidated Investee, Other [Member]

member:EquityMethodInvestments.doc: Investment in the stock of an investee which is adjusted for the investor's share of the earnings or losses of the investee after the date of acquisition.
member:EquityMethodInvestments.label: Equity Method Investments [Member]

member:EquitySecurities.doc: Ownership interest or right to acquire or dispose of ownership interest in corporations and other legal entities for which ownership interest is represented by shares of common or preferred stock, convertible securities, stock rights, or stock warrants.
member:EquitySecurities.label: Equity Securities [Member]

member:EquitySwap.doc: Contracts in which the counterparties exchange a series of cash payments based on (a) an equity index and (b) a fixed or floating interest rate on a notional principal amount. Equity swap contracts typically are tied to a stock index, but sometimes they relate to a particular stock or a defined basket of stocks.
member:EquitySwap.label: Equity Swap [Member]

member:ErrorCorrectionOther.doc: Error correction to previously issued financial statement classified as other.

member:EstimateOfFairValueFairValueDiscl.doc: Measured as an estimate of fair value.
member:EstimateOfFairValueFairValueDiscl.label: Estimate of Fair Value Measurement [Member]

member:ExchangeCleared.doc: Transaction where an organization acts as an intermediary, reconciling orders between transacting parties.
member:ExchangeCleared.label: Exchange Cleared [Member]

member:ExchangeTradedFunds.doc: Investment that follows an index, commodity or basket of assets that trades similar to a stock on an exchange.
member:ExchangeTradedFunds.label: Exchange Traded Funds [Member]

member:ExtendedMaturity.doc: Loan modification for an extension of the term of a loan in which it must be paid.
member:ExtendedMaturity.label: Extended Maturity [Member]

member:ExternalCreditRatingInvestmentGra.doc: External credit-rating that could be used to describe the current status of the payment and performance risk of credit derivatives and guarantee obligations that connote investment grade.
member:ExternalCreditRatingInvestmentGra.label: External Credit Rating, Investment Grade [Member]

member:ExternalCreditRatingNonInvestment.doc: External credit rating used to describe current status of payment and performance risk of credit derivative and guarantee obligation that connote noninvestment grade.
member:ExternalCreditRatingNonInvestment.label: External Credit Rating, Noninvestment Grade [Member]

member:FacilityClosing.doc: Closing of a facility associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructurings pursuant to a plan.
member:FacilityClosing.label: Facility Closing [Member]

member:FairValueHedging.doc: A hedge of the exposure to changes in the fair value of a recognized asset or liability, or of an unrecognized firm commitment, that are attributable to a particular risk.
member:FairValueHedging.label: Fair Value Hedging [Member]

member:FairValueInputsLevel1.doc: Quoted prices in active markets for identical assets or liabilities that the reporting entity can access at the measurement date.
member:FairValueInputsLevel1.label: Fair Value, Inputs, Level 1 [Member]

member:FairValueInputsLevel12And3.doc: Fair value measurement input including quoted price in active market for identical asset or liability reporting entity can access at measurement date (level 1), input other than quoted price included within level 1 either directly or indirectly observable for asset or liability (level 2) and unobservable input reflecting entity's own assumption (level 3).
member:FairValueInputsLevel12And3.label: Fair Value, Inputs, Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 [Member]

member:FairValueInputsLevel2.doc: Inputs other than quoted prices included within level 1 that are observable for an asset or liability, either directly or indirectly, including, but not limited to, quoted prices for similar assets or liabilities in active markets, or quoted prices for identical or similar assets or liabilities in inactive markets.
member:FairValueInputsLevel2.label: Fair Value, Inputs, Level 2 [Member]

member:FairValueInputsLevel3.doc: Unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.
member:FairValueInputsLevel3.label: Fair Value, Inputs, Level 3 [Member]

member:FairValueMeasuredAtNetAssetValueP.doc: Fair value measured at net asset value per share as practical expedient.
member:FairValueMeasuredAtNetAssetValueP.label: Fair Value Measured at Net Asset Value Per Share [Member]

member:FairValueMeasurementsNonrecurring.doc: Infrequent fair value measurement. Includes, but is not limited to, fair value adjustment for impairment of asset, liability or equity, not frequently measured at fair value.
member:FairValueMeasurementsNonrecurring.label: Fair Value, Nonrecurring [Member]

member:FairValueMeasurementsRecurring.doc: Frequent fair value measurement. Includes, but is not limited to, fair value adjustment for impairment of asset, liability or equity, frequently measured at fair value.
member:FairValueMeasurementsRecurring.label: Fair Value, Recurring [Member]

member:FederalFamilyEducationLoanProgram.doc: Guarantee by the U.S. government for government insured loans under the Federal Family Education Loan Program (FFELP).
member:FederalFamilyEducationLoanProgram.label: Federal Family Education Loan Program (FFELP) Guaranteed Loans [Member]

member:FederalHomeLoanBankAdvances.doc: Borrowings from the Federal Home Loan Bank, which are primarily used to cover shortages in the required reserve balance and also in times of liquidity shortages. The member institution executes a promissory note, which is generally collateralized by government securities to the Federal Reserve or loans.
member:FederalHomeLoanBankAdvances.label: Federal Home Loan Bank Advances [Member]

member:FederalHomeLoanBankCertificatesAn.doc: Investments in securities issued by or through the member banks of the federal home loan bank (FHLB).
member:FederalHomeLoanBankCertificatesAn.label: Federal Home Loan Bank Certificates and Obligations (FHLB) [Member]

member:FederalHomeLoanBankOfNewYork.doc: Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) located in New York, New York.
member:FederalHomeLoanBankOfNewYork.label: Federal Home Loan Bank of New York [Member]

member:FederalHomeLoanBankOfPittsburgh.doc: Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) located in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
member:FederalHomeLoanBankOfPittsburgh.label: Federal Home Loan Bank of Pittsburgh [Member]

member:FederalHomeLoanMortgageCorporatio.doc: Investments in debentures, bonds and other debt securities issued by the Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC or Freddie Mac).
member:FederalHomeLoanMortgageCorporatio.label: Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation Certificates and Obligations (FHLMC) [Member]

member:FederalHousingAdministrationLoan.doc: Loans obtained through the Federal Housing Administration, which typically require a lower down payment and lower credit rating than conventional loans.
member:FederalHousingAdministrationLoan.label: Federal Housing Administration Loan [Member]
