member:FederalNationalMortgageAssociatio.doc: Investments in debentures, bonds and other debt securities issued by the Federal National Mortgage Association (FNMA or Fannie Mae).
member:FederalNationalMortgageAssociatio.label: Federal National Mortgage Association Certificates and Obligations (FNMA) [Member]

member:FederalReserveBankAdvances.doc: Borrowings from the Federal Reserve Bank, which are primarily used to cover shortages in the required reserve balance and also in times of liquidity shortages.
member:FederalReserveBankAdvances.label: Federal Reserve Bank Advances [Member]

member:FiduciaryAndTrust.doc: Person or entity with legal duty to act in best interest of client or beneficiary of trust and fiduciary relationship in which one party gives another party right to hold title to asset for benefit of beneficiary.
member:FiduciaryAndTrust.label: Fiduciary and Trust [Member]

member:FinanceLeasesPortfolioSegment.doc: Portfolio segment of the company's total financing receivables related to finance leases.
member:FinanceLeasesPortfolioSegment.label: Finance Leases Portfolio Segment [Member]

member:FinanceReceivables.doc: Amounts due the Company from customers, clients, lessees, borrowers, or others under the terms of its agreements therewith. Such amount may include accrued interest receivable in accordance with the terms of the agreements. The agreements also may contain provisions and related items including a discount or premium, payable on demand, secured, or unsecured, interest bearing or noninterest bearing, among myriad other features and characteristics.
member:FinanceReceivables.label: Financing Receivable [Member]

member:FinancialAssetAcquiredAndNoCredit.doc: Financial asset acquired with no deteriorated credit quality.
member:FinancialAssetAcquiredAndNoCredit.label: Financial Asset Acquired and No Credit Deterioration [Member]

member:FinancialAssetAcquiredWithCreditD.doc: Financial asset acquired with deteriorated credit quality.
member:FinancialAssetAcquiredWithCreditD.label: Financial Asset Acquired with Credit Deterioration [Member]

member:FinancialInstitutionsBorrower.doc: Financial service organization who borrows funds.
member:FinancialInstitutionsBorrower.label: Financial Institutions Borrower [Member]

member:FinancialService.doc: Financial assistance, including, but not limited to, management and maintenance of depositor account, credit card, merchant discount, trust, investment and insurance.
member:FinancialService.label: Financial Service [Member]

member:FinancialServiceOther.doc: Financial assistance, including, but not limited to, management and maintenance of depositor account, credit card, merchant discount, trust, investment and insurance, classified as other.
member:FinancialServiceOther.label: Financial Service, Other [Member]

member:FinancialServicesSector.doc: Sector of the economy consisting of companies engaged in financial services.
member:FinancialServicesSector.label: Financial Services Sector [Member]

member:FinancingReceivables1To29DaysPast.doc: Financial asset fewer than 30 days past due.
member:FinancingReceivables1To29DaysPast.label: Financial Asset, 1 to 29 Days Past Due [Member]

member:FinancingReceivables30To59DaysPas.doc: Financial asset more than 29 days past due but fewer than 60 days past due.
member:FinancingReceivables30To59DaysPas.label: Financial Asset, 30 to 59 Days Past Due [Member]

member:FinancingReceivables60To89DaysPas.doc: Financial asset more than 59 days past due but fewer than 90 days past due.
member:FinancingReceivables60To89DaysPas.label: Financial Asset, 60 to 89 Days Past Due [Member]

member:FinancingReceivablesEqualToGreate.doc: Financial asset equal to or greater than 90 days past due.
member:FinancingReceivablesEqualToGreate.label: Financial Asset, Equal to or Greater than 90 Days Past Due [Member]

member:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssets.doc: Assets, excluding financial assets, that lack physical substance, having a limited useful life.
member:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssets.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets [Member]

member:FirstMortgage.doc: Loan secured by real property that has a first (highest) lien on such property in the event of default by the borrower.
member:FirstMortgage.label: First Mortgage [Member]

member:FitchAAARating.doc: AAA credit rating as defined by the external credit rating agency, Fitch.
member:FitchAAARating.label: Fitch, AAA Rating [Member]

member:FitchAARating.doc: AA credit rating as defined by the external credit rating agency, Fitch.
member:FitchAARating.label: Fitch, AA Rating [Member]

member:FitchARating.doc: A credit rating as defined by the external credit rating agency, Fitch.
member:FitchARating.label: Fitch, A Rating [Member]

member:FitchBBBRating.doc: BBB credit rating as defined by the external credit rating agency, Fitch.

member:FixedAnnuity.doc: Contract that provides a guaranteed stream of fixed payments.
member:FixedAnnuity.label: Fixed Annuity [Member]

member:FixedIncomeFunds.doc: Investment that pools funds from investors to invest in a combination of underlying investments, primarily fixed income investments.
member:FixedIncomeFunds.label: Fixed Income Funds [Member]

member:FixedIncomeInvestments.doc: Investments that regularly generate a fixed amount of interest income. Examples include, but are not limited to, bonds, certificates of deposit, notes and debt securities.
member:FixedIncomeInvestments.label: Fixed Income Investments [Member]

member:FixedIncomeSecurities.doc: Investment that provides a return in the form of fixed periodic payments and eventual return of principal at maturity.
member:FixedIncomeSecurities.label: Fixed Income Securities [Member]

member:FixedMaturities.doc: This element provides types of investments that may be contained within the fixed maturity category which are securities having a stated final repayment date. Examples of items within this category may include bonds, including convertibles and bonds with warrants, and redeemable preferred stocks.
member:FixedMaturities.label: Fixed Maturities [Member]

member:FixedPriceContract.doc: Contract with customer in which amount of consideration is fixed.
member:FixedPriceContract.label: Fixed-Price Contract [Member]

member:FoodAndBeverage.doc: Consumable liquid and non-liquid substance to provide nourishment.
member:FoodAndBeverage.label: Food and Beverage [Member]

member:ForeignCorporateDebtSecurities.doc: Debt security issued by corporation not domiciled in United States of America (US).
member:ForeignCorporateDebtSecurities.label: Debt Security, Corporate, Non-US [Member]

member:ForeignExchange.doc: Trading of derivative or nonderivative instruments whose primary underlying risk is tied to foreign exchange rates.
member:ForeignExchange.label: Foreign Exchange [Member]

member:ForeignExchangeContract.doc: Derivative instrument whose primary underlying risk is tied to foreign exchange rates.
member:ForeignExchangeContract.label: Foreign Exchange Contract [Member]

member:ForeignExchangeForward.doc: Foreign exchange forward traded on an exchange (examples include but are not limited to the International Securities Exchange, Philadelphia Stock Exchange, or the Chicago Mercantile Exchange) for options or future contracts to buy or sell a certain currency, at a specified date, at a fixed exercise exchange rate.
member:ForeignExchangeForward.label: Foreign Exchange Forward [Member]

member:ForeignExchangeOption.doc: An option that allows the holder to buy (if call) or sell (if put) an underlying currency at a fixed exercise rate, expressed as an exchange, during a specified period (an American option) or at a specified date (a European option).
member:ForeignExchangeOption.label: Foreign Exchange Option [Member]

member:ForeignGovernmentDebt.doc: Debt securities (such as bonds) issued by a national, local, or municipal government not within the country of domicile of the entity.
member:ForeignGovernmentDebt.label: Foreign Government Debt [Member]

member:ForeignGovernmentDebtSecurities.doc: Debt security issued by government not domiciled in United States of America (US).
member:ForeignGovernmentDebtSecurities.label: Debt Security, Government, Non-US [Member]

member:ForeignLineOfCredit.doc: Contractual arrangement with a lender under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time, and under which borrowings outstanding may be either short-term or long-term, depending upon the particulars, outside the reporting entity's home country.
member:ForeignLineOfCredit.label: Foreign Line of Credit [Member]

member:ForwardContracts.doc: Contracts negotiated between two parties to purchase and sell a specific quantity of a financial instrument, foreign currency, or commodity at a price specified at origination of the contract, with delivery and settlement at a specified future date.
member:ForwardContracts.label: Forward Contracts [Member]

member:Fuel.doc: Material used for production of energy in form of heat or power. Includes, but is not limited to, coal, gas, and oil.
member:Fuel.label: Fuel [Member]

member:Future.doc: Futures contracts are forward-based contracts to make or take delivery of a specified financial instrument, foreign currency, or commodity at a specified future date or during a specified period at as specified price or yield. Futures are standardized contracts traded on an organized exchange.
member:Future.label: Future [Member]

member:GainLossOnDerivativeInstruments.doc: Primary financial statement caption encompassing gain (loss) on derivative instruments.
member:GainLossOnDerivativeInstruments.label: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments [Member]

member:GasTransmission.doc: System used for the primary purpose of transmitting a gas product to the customer.

member:GeneralLiability.doc: Type of business insurance which provides insurance coverage for a wide variety of liability exposures including, but not limited to, contractual liability, product liability and personal injury liability.
member:GeneralLiability.label: General Liability [Member]

member:GeneralPartner.doc: Party to a partnership business who has unlimited liability.
member:GeneralPartner.label: General Partner [Member]

member:GeographicConcentrationRisk.doc: Reflects the percentage that a specified dollar value on the balance sheet or income statement in the period from one or more specified geographic areas is to a corresponding consolidated, segment, or product line amount. Risk is the materially adverse effects of economic decline or antagonistic political actions resulting in loss of assets, sales volume, labor supply, or source of materials and supplies in a US state or a specified country, continent, or region such as EMEA (Europe, Middle East, Africa).
member:GeographicConcentrationRisk.label: Geographic Concentration Risk [Member]

member:GeographicDistributionDomestic.doc: Allocation of business activity identified as domestic.
member:GeographicDistributionDomestic.label: Geographic Distribution, Domestic [Member]

member:GeographicDistributionForeign.doc: Allocation of business activity identified as foreign.
member:GeographicDistributionForeign.label: Geographic Distribution, Foreign [Member]

member:Gold.doc: Yellow metallic chemical element that is highly ductile and malleable and not subject to oxidation or corrosion.
member:Gold.label: Gold [Member]

member:GoodwillImpairmentLossMethodForFa.doc: Valuation technique using price generated by market transaction involving identical or comparable business.
member:GoodwillImpairmentLossMethodForFa.label: Valuation Technique, Price of Comparable Business [Member]

member:GovernmentContractsConcentrationR.doc: Reflects the percentage that revenues in the period from one or more significant customers is to net revenues, as defined by the entity, such as total net revenues, product line revenues, segment revenues. Risk is the materially adverse effects of termination of a significant contract or group of contracts or from future loss of a significant portion of business with a specified political body or unit thereof, such as Department of Defense, US Navy, New York City.

member:GovernmentGuaranteedCollateral.doc: Collateral guaranteed by government authority or agency to serve as protection against default.

member:GovernmentNationalMortgageAssocia.doc: Investments in debentures, bonds and other debt securities issued by the Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA or Ginnie Mae).
member:GovernmentNationalMortgageAssocia.label: Government National Mortgage Association Certificates and Obligations (GNMA) [Member]

member:GovernmentNationalMortgageAssocia.doc: Government-owned corporation within Department of Housing and Urban Development known as Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA or Ginnie Mae).
member:GovernmentNationalMortgageAssocia.label: Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA) [Member]

member:GovernmentSector.doc: Sector of the economy consisting of government agencies and authorities.

member:GroupPolicies.doc: Contract consisting of insurance coverage issued to organization to provide benefit to more than one individual.
member:GroupPolicies.label: Group Insurance Policy [Member]

member:GuaranteedInvestmentContract.doc: Contract that guarantees interest for a predetermined period of time and repayment of principal.
member:GuaranteedInvestmentContract.label: Guaranteed Investment Contract [Member]

member:GuaranteedMinimumWithdrawalBenefi.doc: Feature in an insurance contract that allows the contract holder to, at a minimum, withdraw a fixed percentage of the annuity premiums on a periodic basis regardless of market performance until the premium is recovered.

member:HealthCare.doc: Service provided for prevention, maintenance, diagnosis or treatment of physical and mental health.
member:HealthCare.label: Health Care [Member]

member:HealthCarePremium.doc: Money received from insurance for service provided for maintenance, diagnosis and treatment of physical and mental health.

member:HedgeFundsEquity.doc: Investments in registered hedge funds that invest in equity securities, taking both long and short positions.

member:HeldtomaturitySecurities.doc: Investments in debt securities classified as held-to-maturity.
member:HeldtomaturitySecurities.label: Held-to-Maturity Securities [Member]

member:HomeEquity.doc: Revolving, open-end loan extended under a line of credit and secured by the borrower's residential property.
member:HomeEquity.label: Home Equity Line of Credit [Member]

member:HomeEquityLoan.doc: Loan based on the equity of the borrower's residential property in which the borrower receives the loan amount upfront. Excludes home equity lines of credit.
member:HomeEquityLoan.label: Home Equity Loan [Member]

member:Hotel.doc: Commercial establishment providing lodging, meal, meeting space and other related service.
member:Hotel.label: Hotel [Member]

member:IPO.doc: First sale of stock by a private company to the public.
member:IPO.label: IPO [Member]

member:ImmediateVariableAnnuity.doc: Contract that provides periodic payments, which vary according to the investment experience of the separate accounts in which the amounts paid to provide for the annuity are allocated, which begin within a short period after the contract is effective.

member:InProcessResearchAndDevelopment.doc: In process investigation of new knowledge useful in developing new product or service or new process or technique or improvement to existing product or process, and translation of knowledge into plan or design for new product or process or for improvement to existing product or process.
member:InProcessResearchAndDevelopment.label: In Process Research and Development [Member]

member:IndefinitelivedIntangibleAssets.doc: Assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, that lack physical substance, having a projected indefinite period of benefit.
member:IndefinitelivedIntangibleAssets.label: Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets [Member]

member:IndemnificationGuarantee.doc: An agreement (contract) that contingently requires the guarantor to make payments to the guaranteed party in compensation for that party's or parties' loss or injury attributable to specified events or actions, such as a patent infringement action against an entity that relied on certain representations as to ownership rights made by a software vendor.
member:IndemnificationGuarantee.label: Indemnification Agreement [Member]

member:IndexedAnnuity.doc: Contract providing interest payment that varies according to index.
member:IndexedAnnuity.label: Indexed Annuity [Member]

member:IndustrialMiscellaneousAndAllOthe.doc: This item represents investments by the reporting entity in equity securities issued by any type of company other than public utilities, banks, trusts, and insurance companies the investments in which are summarized elsewhere.

member:IndustrialProperty.doc: Building designed to house industrial operations and provide the necessary conditions for the operation of industrial equipment.
member:IndustrialProperty.label: Industrial Property [Member]

member:InsuranceSector.doc: Sector of economy consisting of companies engaged in business activity related to insurance.
member:InsuranceSector.label: Insurance Sector [Member]

member:InterestOnlyStrip.doc: Tranche of a securitization that entitles the holder to receive some or all of the interest collected on the underlying mortgages comprising the securitization; a significant risk is prepayment speed greater than the assumption upon which purchase price was based.
member:InterestOnlyStrip.label: Interest-Only-Strip [Member]

member:InterestRateContract.doc: Derivative instrument whose primary underlying risk is tied to the right to receive or pay a sum of money at a given interest rate.
member:InterestRateContract.label: Interest Rate Contract [Member]

member:InterestRateLockCommitments.doc: Commitments to extend credit where the interest rate is locked in advance of funds being disbursed for a specified period of time.
member:InterestRateLockCommitments.label: Interest Rate Lock Commitments [Member]

member:InterestRateRisk.doc: The risk associated with changes in interest rates that effect the value of an interest-bearing asset or liability, and a servicing asset or liability.
member:InterestRateRisk.label: Interest Rate Risk [Member]

member:InterestRateSwap.doc: Forward based contracts in which two parties agree to swap periodic payments that are fixed at the outset of the swap contract with variable payments based on a market interest rate (index rate) over a specified period.
member:InterestRateSwap.label: Interest Rate Swap [Member]

member:InterestRateSwaption.doc: An option granting the owner the right but not the obligation to enter into an interest rate swap.
member:InterestRateSwaption.label: Interest Rate Swaption [Member]

member:InterestSensitiveLife.doc: Contract providing death benefits in which the rate credited by the insurer is adjusted periodically.

member:InternalInvestmentGrade.doc: Credit rating classification developed by the entity in which the probability of default is low and full and timely repayments are expected.
member:InternalInvestmentGrade.label: Internal Investment Grade [Member]

member:InternalNoninvestmentGrade.doc: Credit rating classification developed by the entity in which the probability of default is high and full and timely repayments are not expected.
member:InternalNoninvestmentGrade.label: Internal Noninvestment Grade [Member]

member:IntersegmentElimination.doc: Eliminating entries used in operating segment consolidation.
member:IntersegmentElimination.label: Intersegment Eliminations [Member]

member:IntersubsegmentEliminations.doc: Eliminating entries used in subsegment consolidation.
member:IntersubsegmentEliminations.label: Intersubsegment Eliminations [Member]

member:Investee.doc: A corporation that issued voting stock held by an investor.
member:Investee.label: Investee [Member]

member:InvestmentAdvice.doc: Investment recommendation and research provided to customer.
member:InvestmentAdvice.label: Investment Advice [Member]

member:InvestmentAdvisoryManagementAndAd.doc: Investment advisory, asset management and administrative service. Includes, but is not limited to, distribution and shareholder service; and accounting, tax, legal, regulatory filing, share registration and shareholder correspondence activities.
member:InvestmentAdvisoryManagementAndAd.label: Investment Advisory, Management and Administrative Service [Member]

member:InvestmentContracts.doc: Guarantee by insurance entity to contract holder for specified rate of return on investment for specified period.

member:InvestmentInFederalHomeLoanBankSt.doc: This item represents the amount shown on an entity's books for investments in Federal Home Loan Bank stock.
member:InvestmentInFederalHomeLoanBankSt.label: Investment in Federal Home Loan Bank Stock [Member]

member:InvestmentPerformance.doc: Result achieved from investment. Excludes non-performance related result from asset under management.
member:InvestmentPerformance.label: Investment Performance [Member]

member:Investments.doc: Assets held for their financial return, rather than for the entity's operations.
member:Investments.label: Investments [Member]

member:InvestmentsSegment.doc: Contract providing variable periodic payment and other form of investment.
member:InvestmentsSegment.label: Investment Product [Member]

member:Investor.doc: Business entity or individual that puts money, by purchase or expenditure, in something offering potential profitable returns, such as interest income or appreciation in value.
member:Investor.label: Investor [Member]

member:JuniorSubordinatedDebt.doc: Borrowing that has a lower priority than senior instruments in event of liquidation of the entity's assets.
member:JuniorSubordinatedDebt.label: Junior Subordinated Debt [Member]

member:Land.doc: Part of earth's surface not covered by water.
member:Land.label: Land [Member]

member:LandImprovements.doc: Additions or improvements to real estate held.
member:LandImprovements.label: Land Improvements [Member]

member:Landfill.doc: Authorized waste management facility on or in which collected municipal, construction or hazardous waste is deposited.
member:Landfill.label: Landfill [Member]

member:LatinAmericaDestination.doc: Latin America destinations determined principally based on geographic region as defined by the U.S. Department of Transportation.

member:LeaseAgreements.doc: Contractual agreement that stipulates the lessee pay the lessor for use of an asset.
member:LeaseAgreements.label: Lease Agreements [Member]

member:LeasesAcquiredInPlace.doc: This element represents the amount of value allocated by a lessor (acquirer) to lease agreements which exist at acquisition of a leased property. Such amount may include the value assigned to tenant relationships and excludes the market adjustment component of the value assigned for above or below-market leases acquired.
member:LeasesAcquiredInPlace.label: Leases, Acquired-in-Place [Member]

member:LetterOfCredit.doc: A document typically issued by a financial institution which acts as a guarantee of payment to a beneficiary, or as the source of payment for a specific transaction (for example, wiring funds to a foreign exporter if and when specified merchandise is accepted pursuant to the terms of the letter of credit).
member:LetterOfCredit.label: Letter of Credit [Member]

member:Liability.doc: Liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.
member:Liability.label: Liability [Member]

member:License.doc: Right to use intangible asset. Intangible asset includes, but is not limited to, patent, copyright, technology, manufacturing process, software or trademark.
member:License.label: License [Member]

member:LicenseAndMaintenance.doc: Right to use intangible asset and process of preserving asset. Intangible asset includes, but is not limited to, patent, copyright, technology, manufacturing process, software or trademark.

member:LicensingAgreements.doc: Rights, generally of limited duration, under a license arrangement (for example, to sell or otherwise utilize specified products or processes in a specified territory).
member:LicensingAgreements.label: Licensing Agreements [Member]

member:LifeInsuranceSegment.doc: Contract providing insurance coverage for death benefit.
member:LifeInsuranceSegment.label: Life Insurance Product Line [Member]

member:LimitedPartner.doc: Party to a partnership business who has limited liability.
member:LimitedPartner.label: Limited Partner [Member]

member:LineOfCredit.doc: A contractual arrangement with a lender under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time, and under which borrowings outstanding may be either short-term or long-term, depending upon the particulars.
member:LineOfCredit.label: Line of Credit [Member]

member:LoanOriginationCommitments.doc: Commitments to borrowers or third party investors for the origination of a loan.
member:LoanOriginationCommitments.label: Loan Origination Commitments [Member]

member:LoanPurchaseCommitments.doc: Commitment to purchase loans from a third party.
member:LoanPurchaseCommitments.label: Loan Purchase Commitments [Member]

member:Loans.doc: When a lender gives money or property over other debt securities sold by the issuer. In the event the issuer goes bankrupt, senior debt holders receive priority for [must receive] repayment [prior] relative to junior and unsecured (general) creditors.
member:Loans.label: Loans [Member]

member:LoansAndFinanceReceivables.doc: Contractual rights to receive money on demand or on fixed or determinable dates that is recognized as an asset in the creditor's statement of financial position.
member:LoansAndFinanceReceivables.label: Loans and Finance Receivables [Member]

member:LoansInsuredOrGuaranteedByNonUsGo.doc: Guarantee by non-US government authority for government insured loans.

member:LoansInsuredOrGuaranteedByUsGover.doc: Guarantee by US government authority for government insured loans.
member:LoansInsuredOrGuaranteedByUsGover.label: Loans Insured or Guaranteed by US Government Authorities [Member]

member:LoansPayable.doc: Borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.
member:LoansPayable.label: Loans Payable [Member]

member:LoansReceivable.doc: Amount of money and property lent to borrower in exchange for promise to repay amount borrowed plus interest at date certain in future.
member:LoansReceivable.label: Loans Receivable [Member]

member:Long.doc: Indicates an ownership position in, or purchase of, a security.
member:Long.label: Long [Member]

member:LongTermDebt.doc: Debt arrangement having an initial term longer than one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.
member:LongTermDebt.label: Long-Term Debt [Member]

member:LossOnReacquiredDebt.doc: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of loss incurred on reacquisition or refinancing of debt.
member:LossOnReacquiredDebt.label: Loss on Reacquired Debt [Member]

member:Ltv80To100Percent.doc: Debt-to-value (DTV) ratio from 80 percent to 100 percent. Element name and standard label in DTV [numeric lower end] to [numeric higher end] Percent [Member] format.
member:Ltv80To100Percent.label: Debt-to-Value Ratio, 80 to 100 Percent [Member]

member:LtvLessThan80Percent.doc: Debt-to-value (DTV) ratio less than 80 percent. Element name and standard label in DTV Greater Than [low end numeric value] Percent [Member] or DTV Less Than [high end numeric value] Percent [Member] formats.
member:LtvLessThan80Percent.label: Debt-to-Value Ratio, Less than 80 Percent [Member]

member:MachineryAndEquipment.doc: Tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment.
member:MachineryAndEquipment.label: Machinery and Equipment [Member]

member:MajorityOwnedSubsidiaryUnconsolid.doc: Nonconsolidated entity in which financial interest is held through direct or indirect ownership of more than 50 percent of voting interest but entity is not controlled or broker-dealer has control of entity but control is likely to be temporary.
member:MajorityOwnedSubsidiaryUnconsolid.label: Majority-Owned Subsidiary, Nonconsolidated [Member]

member:MajorityShareholder.doc: Owner that controls more than 50 percent of the voting interest in the entity through direct or indirect ownership.
member:MajorityShareholder.label: Majority Shareholder [Member]

member:ManagementService.doc: Contractually stipulated right to receive compensation for operating and managing business.
member:ManagementService.label: Management Service [Member]

member:ManagementServiceBase.doc: Contractually stipulated right to receive base compensation for operating and managing business.
member:ManagementServiceBase.label: Management Service, Base [Member]

member:ManagementServiceIncentive.doc: Contractually stipulated right to receive incentive compensation for operating and managing business.
member:ManagementServiceIncentive.label: Management Service, Incentive [Member]

member:ManufacturedProductOther.doc: Article or substance produced by labor or machinery, classified as other.
member:ManufacturedProductOther.label: Manufactured Product, Other [Member]

member:MarketApproachValuationTechnique.doc: Valuation approach using price and other relevant information generated by market transaction involving identical or comparable asset, liability, or group of assets and liabilities.
member:MarketApproachValuationTechnique.label: Valuation, Market Approach [Member]

member:MarketingRelatedIntangibleAssets.doc: Marketing-related asset, including, but not limited to, internet domain name, newspaper mast head, and trademark.
member:MarketingRelatedIntangibleAssets.label: Marketing-Related Intangible Assets [Member]

member:MaterialReconcilingItems.doc: Items used in reconciling reportable segments' amounts to consolidated amount. Excludes corporate-level activity.
member:MaterialReconcilingItems.label: Segment Reporting, Reconciling Item, Excluding Corporate Nonsegment [Member]

member:Maturity30To90Days.doc: Maturity period that is more than 29 days but fewer than 91 days from the reporting date for repurchase agreements and similar transactions, for example, but not limited to, securities lending arrangements.
member:Maturity30To90Days.label: Maturity 30 to 90 Days [Member]

member:MaturityOver90Days.doc: Maturity period of over 90 days from the reporting date for repurchase agreements and similar transactions, for example, but not limited to, securities lending arrangements.
member:MaturityOver90Days.label: Maturity Greater than 90 Days [Member]

member:MaturityOvernight.doc: Maturity period of the day after the reporting date for repurchase agreements and similar transactions, for example, but not limited to, securities lending arrangements.
member:MaturityOvernight.label: Maturity Overnight [Member]

member:MaturityOvernightAndOnDemand.doc: Maturity period of the day after the reporting date and transactions on demand for repurchase agreements and similar transactions, for example, but not limited to, securities lending arrangements.
member:MaturityOvernightAndOnDemand.label: Maturity Overnight and on Demand [Member]

member:MaturityUpTo30Days.doc: Maturity period of up to 30 days from the reporting date for repurchase agreements and similar transactions, for example, but not limited to, securities lending arrangements.
member:MaturityUpTo30Days.label: Maturity Less than 30 Days [Member]

member:Maximum.doc: Upper limit of the provided range.
member:Maximum.label: Maximum [Member]

member:MeasurementInputCreditSpread.doc: Measurement input using amount above (below) yield between two debt instruments similar in maturity, but different in credit quality.
member:MeasurementInputCreditSpread.label: Measurement Input, Credit Spread [Member]

member:MeasurementInputEbitdaMultiple.doc: Measurement input using earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) multiple.
member:MeasurementInputEbitdaMultiple.label: Measurement Input, EBITDA Multiple [Member]

member:MeasurementInputRevenueMultiple.doc: Measurement input using market valuation of entity divided by revenue.
member:MeasurementInputRevenueMultiple.label: Measurement Input, Revenue Multiple [Member]

member:MediumTermNotes.doc: Debt instruments with maturities ranging from five to ten years.
member:MediumTermNotes.label: Medium-Term Note [Member]

member:MemberUnits.doc: Ownership interest in limited liability company (LLC).
member:MemberUnits.label: Member Units [Member]

member:MidwestRegion.doc: Region of United States of America (US) designated as Midwest.
member:MidwestRegion.label: US Midwest Region [Member]

member:Minimum.doc: Lower limit of the provided range.
member:Minimum.label: Minimum [Member]

member:MiscellaneousInvestments.doc: Investment in security providing ownership interest classified as miscellaneous.

member:MoneyMarketFunds.doc: Fund that invests in short-term money-market instruments, for example, but not limited to, commercial paper, banker's acceptances, repurchase agreements, government securities, certificates of deposit, and other highly liquid securities.
member:MoneyMarketFunds.label: Money Market Funds [Member]

member:MoodysAaaRating.doc: Aaa credit rating as defined by the external credit rating agency, Moody's.
member:MoodysAaaRating.label: Moody's, Aaa Rating [Member]

member:MortgageBackedSecuritiesIssuedByP.doc: Debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans (mortgages), issued by non-governmental sponsored enterprises.
member:MortgageBackedSecuritiesIssuedByP.label: Mortgage-Backed Securities, Issued by Private Enterprises [Member]

member:MortgageBackedSecuritiesIssuedByU.doc: Debt security collateralized by real estate mortgage loan issued by U.S. government-sponsored enterprise (GSE), including, but not limited to, Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC or Freddie Mac), Federal National Mortgage Association (FNMA or Fannie Mae), and Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).
member:MortgageBackedSecuritiesIssuedByU.label: Mortgage-Backed Security, Issued by US Government-Sponsored Enterprise [Member]

member:MortgageBackedSecuritiesOther.doc: Securities collateralized by other mortgage loans.
member:MortgageBackedSecuritiesOther.label: Mortgage-Backed Securities, Other [Member]

member:MortgageBanking.doc: Origination or servicing of loan secured by real property.
member:MortgageBanking.label: Mortgage Banking [Member]

member:MortgageReceivables.doc: Amounts due the Company for loans secured by the collateral of specified real estate property and which loan the borrower (debtor) is obligated to repay in accordance with a predetermined set of payments.
member:MortgageReceivables.label: Mortgage Receivable [Member]

member:Mortgages.doc: A loan to finance the purchase of real estate where the lender has a lien on the property as collateral for the loan.
member:Mortgages.label: Mortgages [Member]

member:Multifamily.doc: Residential building containing multiple separate housing units.
member:Multifamily.label: Multifamily [Member]

member:MunicipalBonds.doc: Long-term debt securities issued by state, city or local governments or the agencies operated by state, city or local governments.
member:MunicipalBonds.label: Municipal Bonds [Member]

member:MunicipalNotes.doc: Short-term debt securities issued by state, city or local governments or the agencies operated by state, city or local governments.
member:MunicipalNotes.label: Municipal Notes [Member]

member:MutualFund.doc: Regulated investment instrument that pools funds from multiple investors to invest principally in a portfolio of securities and money market instruments to match the investment objective.
member:MutualFund.label: Mutual Fund [Member]

member:NaturalGasGatheringTransportation.doc: Process related to midstream and downstream activity for flammable gas occurring naturally underground. Activity includes, but is not limited to, refining, marketing, gathering from well, processing to remove impurity, storage, transmission, and sale of natural gas and related products.
member:NaturalGasGatheringTransportation.label: Natural Gas, Gathering, Transportation, Marketing and Processing [Member]

member:NaturalGasLiquidsReserves.doc: Liquid or liquefied hydrocarbon produced in manufacture, purification, and stabilization of natural gas (NGL). Excludes crude oil, natural gas, synthetic oil and gas, and other nonrenewable natural resources.
member:NaturalGasLiquidsReserves.label: Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) [Member]

member:NaturalGasMidstream.doc: Process related to midstream activity for flammable gas occurring naturally underground. Activity includes, but is not limited to, gathering from well, processing to remove impurity, storage, transmission, and sale of natural gas and related products.
member:NaturalGasMidstream.label: Natural Gas, Midstream [Member]

member:NaturalGasProcessingPlant.doc: Plant used in connection with natural gas operations.
member:NaturalGasProcessingPlant.label: Natural Gas Processing Plant [Member]

member:NaturalGasProduction.doc: Process of obtaining and processing of flammable gas occurring naturally underground.
member:NaturalGasProduction.label: Natural Gas, Production [Member]

member:NaturalGasReserves.doc: Natural gas composed primarily of methane gas, excluding liquid or condensate natural gas.
member:NaturalGasReserves.label: Natural Gas [Member]

member:NaturalGasStorage.doc: Process of maintaining flammable gas occurring naturally underground in facility for future use.

member:NaturalGasUsRegulated.doc: Generation, transmission and distribution of flammable gas occurring naturally underground regulated by government or agency in United States.
member:NaturalGasUsRegulated.label: Natural Gas, US Regulated [Member]

member:NetAssetsSegment.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the total assets less the total liabilities of a business segment when it serves as a benchmark in a concentration of risk calculation.

member:NetInvestmentHedging.doc: Hedges of a net investment in a foreign operation.
member:NetInvestmentHedging.label: Net Investment Hedging [Member]

member:NonGuarantorSubsidiaries.doc: Entity owned or controlled not guaranteeing issuance of security by another subsidiary or parent. Excludes entity in which broker-dealer holds controlling financial interest but control is likely to be temporary.
member:NonGuarantorSubsidiaries.label: Non-Guarantor Subsidiaries [Member]

member:NonUs.doc: Countries excluding the United States of America (US).
member:NonUs.label: Non-US [Member]

member:NoncompeteAgreements.doc: Agreement in which one party agrees not to pursue a similar trade in competition with another party.
member:NoncompeteAgreements.label: Noncompete Agreements [Member]

member:NoncontrollingInterest.doc: This element represents that portion of equity (net assets) in a subsidiary not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent. A noncontrolling interest is sometimes called a minority interest.
member:NoncontrollingInterest.label: Noncontrolling Interest [Member]

member:NoncumulativePreferredStock.doc: Preferred stock upon which unpaid dividends do not accrue.
member:NoncumulativePreferredStock.label: Noncumulative Preferred Stock [Member]

member:Nondesignated.doc: Derivative instrument not designated as hedging instrument under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
member:Nondesignated.label: Not Designated as Hedging Instrument [Member]

member:NonperformingFinancingReceivable.doc: Category status of financial instruments in which payments are past due in accordance with the terms of the contract. Financial instruments include, but are not limited to, financing receivables, loans, debt, and investments.
member:NonperformingFinancingReceivable.label: Nonperforming Financial Instruments [Member]

member:Nonrecourse.doc: Liability for which creditor does not have recourse to debtor but rather has recourse only to property used for collateral in transaction or other specific property.
member:Nonrecourse.label: Nonrecourse [Member]

member:NonredeemablePreferredStock.doc: Preferred shares that are not redeemable before liquidation of the entity. Preferred shares may provide a preferential dividend to the dividend on common stock and may take precedence over common stock in the event of a liquidation. Preferred shares typically represent an ownership interest in the company.
member:NonredeemablePreferredStock.label: Nonredeemable Preferred Stock [Member]

member:NonrelatedParty.doc: Party not related to reporting entity.
member:NonrelatedParty.label: Nonrelated Party [Member]

member:NontaxableMunicipalBonds.doc: Long-term debt securities issued by state, city or local governments or the agencies operated by state, city or local governments that are not taxable.
member:NontaxableMunicipalBonds.label: Nontaxable Municipal Bonds [Member]

member:NonvotingCommonStock.doc: Common stock securities that do not empower a holder to vote on corporate resolutions or the election of directors.
member:NonvotingCommonStock.label: Nonvoting Common Stock [Member]

member:NortheastRegion.doc: Region of United States of America (US) designated as Northeast.
member:NortheastRegion.label: US Northeast Region [Member]

member:NotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentE.doc: Derivative instrument, not designated as hedging instrument under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), used as economic hedge for exposure to risk.
member:NotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentE.label: Not Designated as Hedging Instrument, Economic Hedge [Member]

member:NotesPayableOtherPayables.doc: A written promise to pay a note to a third party.
member:NotesPayableOtherPayables.label: Notes Payable, Other Payables [Member]

member:NotesPayableToBanks.doc: A written promise to pay a note to a bank.
member:NotesPayableToBanks.label: Notes Payable to Banks [Member]

member:NotesReceivable.doc: An amount representing an agreement for an unconditional promise by the maker to pay the Entity (holder) a definite sum of money at a future date(s) within one year of the balance sheet date. Such amount may include accrued interest receivable in accordance with the terms of the note. The note also may contain provisions including a discount or premium, payable on demand, secured, or unsecured, interest bearing or noninterest bearing, among myriad other features and characteristics.
member:NotesReceivable.label: Notes Receivable [Member]

member:NuclearPlant.doc: Plant used in connection with the generation of nuclear energy.
member:NuclearPlant.label: Nuclear Plant [Member]

member:OffMarketFavorableLease.doc: Identifiable intangible asset established upon acquisition based on a favorable difference between the terms of an acquired lease and the current market terms for that lease.
member:OffMarketFavorableLease.label: Off-Market Favorable Lease [Member]

member:OfficeBuilding.doc: Building designed primarily for the conduct of business, for example, but not limited to, administration, clerical services, and consultation.
member:OfficeBuilding.label: Office Building [Member]

member:OilAndCondensate.doc: Viscous liquid derived from petroleum and product of conversion of gas into liquid during production.
member:OilAndCondensate.label: Oil and Condensate [Member]

member:OilAndGasOperationAndMaintenance.doc: Process related to operation and maintenance of wells and related equipment and facility used for production of viscous liquid derived from petroleum and flammable gas occurring naturally underground. Includes, but is not limited to, depreciation and applicable operating cost to support equipment and facility.

member:OilAndGasProperties.doc: Assets used to produce oil or gas.
member:OilAndGasProperties.label: Oil and Gas Properties [Member]

member:OilAndGasPurchased.doc: Viscous liquid derived from petroleum and flammable gas occurring naturally underground, purchased from another party.

member:OilAndGasService.doc: Service for oil and gas activity, including, but not limited to, drilling, analytic evaluation, transportation, and other supporting contractor activity.
member:OilAndGasService.label: Oil and Gas Service [Member]

member:OilReserves.doc: Crude oil, which may also include condensate and natural gas liquids.
member:OilReserves.label: Crude Oil, Condensate, and Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) [Member]

member:OperatingSegments.doc: Identifies components of an entity that engage in business activities from which they may earn revenue and incur expenses, including transactions with other components of the same entity.
member:OperatingSegments.label: Operating Segments [Member]

member:OtherAdditionalCapital.doc: This element represents a category to capture additional Paid-in Capital other than attributable to capital contributed by shareholders in excess of the par or stated value of the common or preferred stock issued by an entity. Certain entities report two components of additional Paid-in Capital consisting of (i) capital in excess of par or stated value and (ii) other additional capital. This member is only to be used if the entity distinguishes between additional Paid-in Capital and other additional capital in its financial statements. If using this element, the preparer would be expected to elevate the Other Additional Capital [Member] to the same level as the Additional Paid-in Capital [Member].
member:OtherAdditionalCapital.label: Other Additional Capital [Member]

member:OtherAffiliates.doc: A category that identifies other affiliates.
member:OtherAffiliates.label: Other Affiliates [Member]

member:OtherAggregatedInvestments.doc: Other investments in debt and equity securities and other forms of securities that provide ownership interests.
member:OtherAggregatedInvestments.label: Other Security Investments [Member]

member:OtherCapitalizedPropertyPlantAndE.doc: All other long term capitalized assets related to property plant and equipment not otherwise previously categorized.
member:OtherCapitalizedPropertyPlantAndE.label: Other Capitalized Property Plant and Equipment [Member]

member:OtherComprehensiveIncome.doc: Primary financial statement caption in which reported facts about other comprehensive income have been included.
member:OtherComprehensiveIncome.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) [Member]

member:OtherContract.doc: Derivative instrument whose primary underlying risk is classified as other.
member:OtherContract.label: Other Contract [Member]

member:OtherCreditDerivatives.doc: Credit derivative contract classified as other.
member:OtherCreditDerivatives.label: Other Credit Derivatives [Member]

member:OtherDebtSecurities.doc: Investments in debt securities classified as other.
member:OtherDebtSecurities.label: Other Debt Obligations [Member]

member:OtherExpense.doc: Primary financial statement caption encompassing other expense.
member:OtherExpense.label: Other Expense [Member]

member:OtherInsuranceProductLine.doc: Contract providing insurance coverage, classified as other.
member:OtherInsuranceProductLine.label: Insurance, Other [Member]

member:OtherInvestees.doc: Investment in group of nonconsolidated investees classified as other.
member:OtherInvestees.label: Nonconsolidated Investees, Other [Member]

member:OtherInvestmentCompanies.doc: Investment in other investment companies (as defined).

member:OtherInvestments.doc: Primary financial statement caption encompassing other investments.
member:OtherInvestments.label: Other Investments [Member]

member:OtherLongdurationInsuranceProduct.doc: Contract providing long-duration insurance coverage, classified as other.

member:OtherMachineryAndEquipment.doc: Other tangible personal property, nonconsumable in nature, with finite lives used to produce goods and services.
member:OtherMachineryAndEquipment.label: Other Machinery and Equipment [Member]

member:OtherNonoperatingIncomeExpense.doc: Primary financial statement caption encompassing other nonoperating income (expense).
member:OtherNonoperatingIncomeExpense.label: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense) [Member]

member:OtherPostretirementBenefitPlansDe.doc: Plan designed to provide other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans. Excludes pension benefits.
member:OtherPostretirementBenefitPlansDe.label: Other Postretirement Benefits Plan [Member]

member:OtherRegulatoryAssetsLiabilities.doc: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of other costs incurred.
member:OtherRegulatoryAssetsLiabilities.label: Other Regulatory Assets (Liabilities) [Member]

member:OtherRestructuring.doc: Restructuring and related activities classified as other.
member:OtherRestructuring.label: Other Restructuring [Member]

member:OtherShortdurationInsuranceProduc.doc: Contract providing short-duration insurance coverage, classified as other.

member:OtherThanSecuritiesInvestment.doc: When the investment holdings table includes investments other than securities, this member categorizes all non-security investments to segregate them from security investments.
member:OtherThanSecuritiesInvestment.label: Other than Securities Investment [Member]

member:OtherTrading.doc: Trading in a derivative instrument whose primary underlying risk is classified as other.
member:OtherTrading.label: Other Trading [Member]

member:OverAllotmentOption.doc: Right given to the underwriter to sell additional shares over the initial allotment.
member:OverAllotmentOption.label: Over-Allotment Option [Member]

member:OverTheCounter.doc: Transaction that does not take place on an organized exchange.
member:OverTheCounter.label: Over-the-Counter [Member]

member:PacificDestination.doc: Pacific destinations determined principally based on geographic region as defined by the U.S. Department of Transportation.

member:Parent.doc: Portion of equity, or net assets, in the consolidated entity attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent. Excludes noncontrolling interests.
member:Parent.label: Parent [Member]

member:ParentCompany.doc: Registrant with controlling financial interest in one or more subsidiaries. Controlling interest in subsidiary includes, but is not limited to, primary beneficiary of variable interest entity (VIE). Controlling interest in subsidiary excludes broker-dealer with controlling financial interest in subsidiary but control is likely to be temporary.
member:ParentCompany.label: Parent Company [Member]

member:ParticipatingLifeInsurancePolicy.doc: Contract providing death benefits that entitle the policyholder to a portion of earnings or surplus through policy dividends.
member:ParticipatingLifeInsurancePolicy.label: Participating Life Insurance Contract [Member]

member:ParticipatingMortgages.doc: Mortgage that gives the lender the right to share in the appreciation of fair value or results of operations of the mortgaged real estate project.
member:ParticipatingMortgages.label: Participating Mortgages [Member]

member:Partnership.doc: Legal entity in the form of a partnership created to conduct business.
member:Partnership.label: Partnership [Member]

member:PartnershipInterest.doc: A general or limited ownership interest in a partnership or unincorporated joint venture.
member:PartnershipInterest.label: Partnership Interest [Member]

member:Pass.doc: A category of financing receivables not considered to be special mention, substandard, doubtful, and loss receivables.
member:Pass.label: Pass [Member]

member:Passenger.doc: Person traveling between destinations and not involved in operation of conveyance, including, but not limited to, train, bus, boat and automobile.
member:Passenger.label: Passenger [Member]

member:PaymentDeferral.doc: Loan modification for a temporary postponement of loan payments.
member:PaymentDeferral.label: Payment Deferral [Member]

member:PensionAndOtherPostretirementPlan.doc: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of pension and other postretirement costs.
member:PensionAndOtherPostretirementPlan.label: Pension and Other Postretirement Plans Costs [Member]

member:PensionCosts.doc: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of pension costs.
member:PensionCosts.label: Pension Costs [Member]

member:PensionPlansDefinedBenefit.doc: Plan designed to provide participant with pension benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans. Excludes other postretirement benefits.
member:PensionPlansDefinedBenefit.label: Pension Plan [Member]

member:PerformanceShares.doc: Share-based payment arrangement awarded for meeting performance target.
member:PerformanceShares.label: Performance Shares [Member]

member:PerformingFinancingReceivable.doc: Category status of financial instruments in which payments are received or paid on a timely basis in accordance with the terms of the contract. Financial instruments include, but are not limited to, financing receivables, loans, debt instruments, and investments.
member:PerformingFinancingReceivable.label: Performing Financial Instruments [Member]

member:PolicyLoans.doc: Loan issued by an insurance company, collateralized by the cash value of the borrower's life insurance policy.

member:PolicyholderAccountBalanceAboveGu.doc: Range from 1 basis point to 50 basis points above guaranteed minimum crediting rate on policyholder account balance.
Range from 51 basis points to 150 basis points above guaranteed minimum crediting rate on policyholder account balance.
Range from 151 basis points and greater above guaranteed minimum crediting rate on policyholder account balance.

member:PolicyholderAccountBalanceAtGuara.doc: Range at zero basis point above guaranteed minimum crediting rate on policyholder account balance.

member:PolicyholderAccountBalanceGuarant.doc: Range of guaranteed minimum crediting rate on policyholder account balance from 4.00 percent and greater.

member:PortionAtFairValueFairValueDisclo.doc: Measured at fair value for financial reporting purposes.
member:PortionAtFairValueFairValueDisclo.label: Portion at Fair Value Measurement [Member]

member:PortionAtOtherThanFairValueFairVa.label: Portion at Other than Fair Value Measurement [Member]

member:PostretirementBenefitCosts.doc: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of postretirement benefit costs.

member:PreferredClassA.doc: Outstanding nonredeemable preferred class A stock or outstanding convertible preferred class A stock. Classified within stockholders' equity if nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer. Classified within temporary equity if redemption is outside the control of the issuer.
member:PreferredClassA.label: Preferred Class A [Member]

member:PreferredClassB.doc: Outstanding nonredeemable preferred class B stock or outstanding preferred class B stock. Classified within stockholders' equity if nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer. Classified within temporary equity if redemption is outside the control of the issuer.
member:PreferredClassB.label: Preferred Class B [Member]

member:PreferredStock.doc: Preferred shares may provide a preferential dividend to the dividend on common stock and may take precedence over common stock in the event of a liquidation. Preferred shares typically represent an ownership interest in the company.
member:PreferredStock.label: Preferred Stock [Member]

member:PreferredStockIncludingAdditional.doc: Preferred stock held by shareholders with par value plus amounts in excess of par value or issuance value (in cases of no-par value stock).
member:PreferredStockIncludingAdditional.label: Preferred Stock Including Additional Paid in Capital [Member]

member:PrepaidExpensesAndOtherCurrentAss.doc: Primary financial statement caption encompassing prepaid expenses and other current assets.
member:PrepaidExpensesAndOtherCurrentAss.label: Prepaid Expenses and Other Current Assets [Member]

member:PriceRiskDerivative.doc: Derivative instrument whose primary underlying is tied to price risk.
member:PriceRiskDerivative.label: Price Risk Derivative [Member]

member:PrincipalOwner.doc: Owner of record or known beneficial owner of more than 10 percent of the voting interests of the entity.
member:PrincipalOwner.label: Principal Owner [Member]

member:PrivateEquityFunds.doc: Investments held in private equity funds.
member:PrivateEquityFunds.label: Private Equity Funds [Member]

member:PrivateEquityFundsDomestic.doc: Private equity fund investing in company domiciled in United States of America (US).

member:PrivateEquityFundsForeign.doc: Private equity fund investing in company not domiciled in United States of America (US).

member:PrivatePlacement.doc: A private placement is a direct offering of securities to a limited number of sophisticated investors such as insurance companies, pension funds, mezzanine funds, stock funds and trusts.
member:PrivatePlacement.label: Private Placement [Member]

member:Product.doc: Article or substance produced by nature, labor or machinery.
member:Product.label: Product [Member]

member:ProductAndServiceOther.doc: Article or substance produced by nature, labor or machinery and act of providing assistance, classified as other.
member:ProductAndServiceOther.label: Product and Service, Other [Member]

member:ProductFinancingArrangement.doc: Arrangement that in form is a sale with full right of return but in substance is a financing in that the financier is not the end customer, is not at risk other than credit risk similar to any other form of lending arrangement, and typically is repaid from collections of sales made to actual customers including an amount that constitutes interest.
member:ProductFinancingArrangement.label: Product Financing Arrangement [Member]

member:PropertyAndCasualtyCommercialInsu.doc: Contract providing insurance coverage to policyholder on commercial property against property-related loss. Includes, but is not limited to, damage, theft, or legal liability for personal injury.

member:PropertyLiabilityAndCasualtyInsur.doc: Contract providing insurance coverage against property-related loss. Includes, but is not limited to, damage, theft, or legal liability for personal injury.
member:PropertyLiabilityAndCasualtyInsur.label: Property, Liability and Casualty Insurance Product Line [Member]

member:PropertyPlantAndEquipment.doc: Physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.
member:PropertyPlantAndEquipment.label: Property, Plant and Equipment [Member]

member:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentOtherTyp.doc: Long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.
member:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentOtherTyp.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other Types [Member]

member:PublicUtilities.doc: Government regulated service to public including, but not limited to, electricity, natural gas, water, sewage, telephone, and transportation.
member:PublicUtilities.label: Public Utilities [Member]

member:PublicUtilitiesInventoryCoal.doc: Combustible mineral substance consisting of carbonized vegetable matter used as fuel and in production of coal gas, water gas, and coal-tar compound.

member:PublicUtilityBonds.doc: This item represents investments by the reporting entity in fixed maturity securities (bonds) issued by a public utility.

member:RealEstate.doc: Property consisting of land, land improvement and buildings.
member:RealEstate.label: Real Estate [Member]

member:RealEstateFunds.doc: Investments in funds that invest in commercial or residential real estate.
member:RealEstateFunds.label: Real Estate Funds [Member]

member:RealEstateInvestment.doc: This element represents direct equity investments in real estate projects (Land, buildings and improvements owned for income production and capital accretion potential) and certain loans accounted for as real estate investments. For loans accounted for as real estate investments, the entity (lender) has virtually the same risks and rewards as those of owners or joint venture participants. Such arrangements are treated as if the entity actually has an ownership interest in the property. In such arrangements, the entity (lender) participates in expected residual profits, which may be in the form of an equity kicker or a higher than usual effective interest rate. At the outset and during the construction and development of the property, the borrower generally has little or no equity in the property and the entity's (lender's) only source of repayment is the property. The entity (lender) generally (a) agrees to provide substantially all funds to acquire, develop, and construct the property, (b) funds the commitment or origination fees or both, and (c) funds interest during the development and construction of the property.
member:RealEstateInvestment.label: Real Estate Investment [Member]

member:RealEstateLoan.doc: Loan to finance the purchase of real estate, including but not limited to, land or building.
member:RealEstateLoan.label: Real Estate Loan [Member]

member:RealEstateOther.doc: Property consisting of land, land improvement and buildings, classified as other.
member:RealEstateOther.label: Real Estate, Other [Member]

member:ReceivablesFromStockholder.doc: Category of equity that is due from owners or affiliates of the reporting entity (including due from officers or directors) resulting from the sale of stock before the cash payment is received.
member:ReceivablesFromStockholder.label: Receivables from Stockholder [Member]

member:ReclassificationOther.doc: Reclassification affecting comparability of financial statement, classified as other. Excludes amendment to accounting standards, other change in accounting principle, and correction of error.
member:ReclassificationOther.label: Reclassification, Other [Member]

member:ReclassificationOutOfAccumulatedO.doc: Identifies item reclassified out of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss).
member:ReclassificationOutOfAccumulatedO.label: Reclassification out of Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income [Member]

member:ReclassificationSegmentationBasis.doc: Reclassification affecting comparability of financial statement arising from recasting of prior period information from change of segmentation basis.

member:Recourse.doc: Liability for which creditor has recourse to debtor.
member:Recourse.label: Recourse [Member]

member:RedeemableConvertiblePreferredSto.doc: Description of type or class of redeemable convertible preferred stock. Convertible redeemable preferred stock possess conversion and redemption features. The stock has redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer.
member:RedeemableConvertiblePreferredSto.label: Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock [Member]

member:RedeemablePreferredStock.doc: Description of type or class of redeemable preferred stock. For instance, cumulative preferred stock, noncumulative preferred stock, convertible or series.
member:RedeemablePreferredStock.label: Redeemable Preferred Stock [Member]

member:RegionalCarrier.doc: "Carrier either owned by, affiliated with, or under contractual arrangement with a primary ""mainline"" carrier, or its brand, that provides commuter or feeder services to such ""mainline"" carrier."

member:RegulatedOperation.doc: Operation of entities that are regulated by governmental organizations for example, but not limited to, local, state, county, country, or other regulatory organizations.

member:RegulatoryClauseRevenuesUnderReco.doc: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of under-recovered regulatory clause revenue.

member:ReinsuranceRecoverableForPaidAndU.doc: Reinsurance recoverable, after valuation allowance, under reinsurance contract. Includes, but is not limited to, settled and unsettled claims, incurred but not reported loss, loss adjustment expense, policy benefits and policy reserves.

member:ReinsurerConcentrationRisk.doc: Concentration risk of a reinsurer to a specified benchmark, such as reinsurance recoverables.
member:ReinsurerConcentrationRisk.label: Reinsurer Concentration Risk [Member]

member:RelatedParty.doc: Party related to reporting entity. Includes, but is not limited to, affiliate, entity for which investment is accounted for by equity method, trust for benefit of employees, and principal owner, management, and members of immediate family.
member:RelatedParty.label: Related Party [Member]

member:RemovalCosts.doc: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of removal costs.
member:RemovalCosts.label: Removal Costs [Member]

member:RenewableEnergyProgram.doc: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of costs related to implementation of renewable energy program.
member:RenewableEnergyProgram.label: Renewable Energy Program [Member]

member:ReportableLegalEntities.doc: Legal entities of the consolidated entity reporting separate financial information in the entity's financial statements.
member:ReportableLegalEntities.label: Reportable Legal Entities [Member]

member:ReportableSegmentAggregationBefor.doc: Aggregation of reportable segments before other operating segment. Excludes intersegment elimination and reconciling item.
member:ReportableSegmentAggregationBefor.label: Reportable Segment, Aggregation before Other Operating Segment [Member]

member:RepurchaseAgreements.doc: Investments represented by an agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Such agreements are generally short-term in nature.
member:RepurchaseAgreements.label: Repurchase Agreements [Member]

member:ResidentialMortgage.doc: Loan to purchase or refinance residential real estate for example, but not limited to, a home, in which the real estate itself serves as collateral for the loan.
member:ResidentialMortgage.label: Residential Mortgage [Member]

member:ResidentialMortgageBackedSecuriti.doc: Securities collateralized by residential real estate mortgage loans.
member:ResidentialMortgageBackedSecuriti.label: Residential Mortgage-Backed Securities [Member]

member:ResidentialPortfolioSegment.doc: Portfolio segment of the company's total financing receivables related to residential financing receivables.
member:ResidentialPortfolioSegment.label: Residential Portfolio Segment [Member]

member:ResidentialRealEstate.doc: Property that is used as a home.
member:ResidentialRealEstate.label: Residential Real Estate [Member]

member:RestatementAdjustment.doc: Cumulative increase (decrease) for adjustment to previously issued financial statements. Includes, but is not limited to, adjustment for retrospective application of amendment to accounting standards, other change in accounting principle, correction of error, and other revision.
member:RestatementAdjustment.label: Revision of Prior Period, Adjustment [Member]

member:RestrictedStockUnitsRSU.doc: Share instrument which is convertible to stock or an equivalent amount of cash, after a specified period of time or when specified performance conditions are met.
member:RestrictedStockUnitsRSU.label: Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) [Member]

member:Retail.doc: Sale of product directly to consumer.
member:Retail.label: Retail [Member]

member:RetailSite.doc: Locations where products are offered for sale to consumers.
member:RetailSite.label: Retail Site [Member]

member:RetainedEarningsAppropriated.doc: Accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) not available for dividend distribution. Includes, but is not limited to, retained earnings appropriated for specific business purpose.
member:RetainedEarningsAppropriated.label: Retained Earnings, Appropriated [Member]

member:RetainedEarningsUnappropriated.doc: Accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) available for dividend distribution. Includes, but is not limited to, retained earnings not appropriated for specific business purpose.
member:RetainedEarningsUnappropriated.label: Retained Earnings, Unappropriated [Member]

member:RevenueSubjectToRefund.doc: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of revenue subject to refund.
member:RevenueSubjectToRefund.label: Revenue Subject to Refund [Member]

member:RevisionOfPriorPeriodAccountingSt.doc: Cumulative increase (decrease) to previously issued financial statements for retrospective application of amendment to accounting standards and adjustment for reclassification from amendment to accounting standards.
member:RevisionOfPriorPeriodAccountingSt.label: Revision of Prior Period, Accounting Standards Update, Adjustment [Member]

member:RevisionOfPriorPeriodErrorCorrect.doc: Cumulative increase (decrease) to previously issued financial statements for correction of error.
member:RevisionOfPriorPeriodErrorCorrect.label: Revision of Prior Period, Error Correction, Adjustment [Member]

member:RevisionOfPriorPeriodReclassifica.doc: Cumulative increase (decrease) to previously issued financial statements for reclassification. Excludes adjustment for reclassification from amendment to accounting standards.
member:RevisionOfPriorPeriodReclassifica.label: Revision of Prior Period, Reclassification, Adjustment [Member]

member:RevolvingCreditFacility.doc: Arrangement in which loan proceeds can continuously be obtained following repayments, but the total amount borrowed cannot exceed a specified maximum amount.
member:RevolvingCreditFacility.label: Revolving Credit Facility [Member]

member:Royalty.doc: Money for usage-based right to asset.
member:Royalty.label: Royalty [Member]

member:SalesChannelDirectlyToConsumer.doc: Contract with customer in which good or service is transferred directly to consumer.
member:SalesChannelDirectlyToConsumer.label: Sales Channel, Directly to Consumer [Member]

member:SalesChannelThroughIntermediary.doc: Contract with customer in which good or service is transferred through intermediary.
member:SalesChannelThroughIntermediary.label: Sales Channel, Through Intermediary [Member]

member:ScenarioAdjustment.doc: "Domain member used to indicate figures that are adjustments during a period or as of a point in time. This domain member would never be expected to appear in a relationship group without the ""Scenario, Previously Reported"" Member with the same parent."
member:ScenarioAdjustment.label: Scenario, Adjustment [Member]

member:ScenarioForecast.doc: Information reported for future period. Excludes information expected to be reported in future period for effect on historical fact.
member:ScenarioForecast.label: Forecast [Member]

member:ScenarioPlan.doc: The scenario under which facts represent plans as distinct from actual.
member:ScenarioPlan.label: Scenario, Plan [Member]

member:ScenarioPreviouslyReported.doc: Represents amount as previously reported before adjustment for retrospective application of amendment to accounting standards, other change in accounting principle, correction of error, and other revision.
member:ScenarioPreviouslyReported.label: Previously Reported [Member]

member:SecuredDebt.doc: Collateralized debt obligation backed by, for example, but not limited to, pledge, mortgage or other lien on the entity's assets.
member:SecuredDebt.label: Secured Debt [Member]

member:SecuritiesAssets.doc: A share, participation, or other interest in property or in an enterprise of the issuer or an obligation of the issuer that (a) either is represented by an instrument issued in bearer or registered form or, if not represented by an instrument, is registered in books maintained to record transfers by or on behalf of the issuer, (b) is of a type commonly dealt in on securities exchanges or markets or, when represented by an instrument, is commonly recognized in any area in which it is issued or dealt in as a medium for investment, and (c) either is one of a class or series or by its terms is divisible into a class or series of shares, participations, interest, or obligations.
member:SecuritiesAssets.label: Securities (Assets) [Member]

member:SecuritiesInvestment.doc: This member categorizes all investments in securities to segregate them from other than security investments.
member:SecuritiesInvestment.label: Securities Investment [Member]

member:SecuritiesLoanedOrSoldUnderAgreem.doc: The amount of securities that an institution sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price, net of any reductions or offsets.

member:SecuritiesSoldNotYetPurchased.doc: Proprietary securities transactions entered into by the entity (broker-dealer) for trading or investment purposes.

member:SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRe.doc: The securities that an institution sells and agrees to repurchase (the identical or substantially the same securities) as a seller-borrower at a specified date for a specified price, also known as a repurchase agreement, or repo. Most repos involve obligations of the federal government or its agencies, but other financial instruments, such as commercial paper, banker's acceptances, and negotiable certificates of deposit, are sometimes used in repos.
member:SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRe.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase [Member]

member:SegmentContinuingOperations.doc: Component of an entity expected to operate in the foreseeable future.
member:SegmentContinuingOperations.label: Continuing Operations [Member]

member:SegmentDiscontinuedOperations.doc: Component or group of components representing strategic shift that has or will have major effect on operation and financial result, classified as held-for-sale or disposed of by sale or by means other than sale, and business and nonprofit activity on acquisition and upon joint venture formation, classified as held-for-sale.
member:SegmentDiscontinuedOperations.label: Discontinued Operations [Member]

member:SelfPay.doc: Patients who pay out of pocket for a health-related service in absence of insurance to cover the medical or surgical procedure performed.
member:SelfPay.label: Self-Pay [Member]

member:SeniorLien.doc: Legal right, before the claims of other creditors, of a creditor to possess property or other collateral in satisfaction of an outstanding debt in the event of borrower default or bankruptcy. Excludes first mortgage loans.
member:SeniorLien.label: Senior Lien [Member]

member:SeniorLoans.doc: A senior loan takes priority over other debt securities sold by the issuer. In the event the issuer goes bankrupt, senior debt holders receive priority for [must receive] repayment [prior] relative to junior and unsecured (general) creditors.
member:SeniorLoans.label: Senior Loans [Member]

member:SeniorNotes.doc: Bond that takes priority over other debt securities sold by the issuer. In the event the issuer goes bankrupt, senior debt holders receive priority for (must receive) repayment prior to (relative to) junior and unsecured (general) creditors.
member:SeniorNotes.label: Senior Notes [Member]

member:SeniorSubordinatedNotes.doc: A senior subordinated note is a bond that takes priority over other debt securities sold by the issuer. In the event the issuer goes bankrupt, senior subordinated debt holders receive priority for [must receive] repayment [prior] relative to junior and unsecured (general) creditors. However senior subordinated notes are junior to Senior Notes and Senior bond holders.
member:SeniorSubordinatedNotes.label: Senior Subordinated Notes [Member]

member:SeparateAccountCashAndCashEquival.doc: Cash and cash equivalent in which separate account asset is invested.

member:SeparateAccountDebtSecurity.doc: Debt instrument issued by corporation, government, or governmental agency, municipality, and other institution; in which separate account asset is invested.
member:SeparateAccountDebtSecurity.label: Separate Account, Debt Security [Member]

member:SeparateAccountEquitySecurity.doc: Ownership interest or right to acquire or dispose of ownership interest in corporation or other legal entity, in which separate account asset is invested.

member:SeparateAccountMortgageBackedSecu.doc: Security collateralized by real estate mortgage loan, in which separate account asset is invested.

member:SeparateAccountRealEstate.doc: Property composed of building, land and land improvement, in which separate account asset is invested.

member:SeparateAccountShortTermInvestmen.doc: Investment held with maturity or intent to sell or dispose of within one year or normal operating cycle, if longer, in which separate account asset is invested.

member:SeriesOfIndividuallyImmaterialBus.doc: Series of individually immaterial business combinations.
member:SeriesOfIndividuallyImmaterialBus.label: Business Combination, Series of Individually Immaterial Business Combinations [Member]

member:Service.doc: Assistance, including, but not limited to, technology, license and maintenance, license and service, maintenance, oil and gas, and financial service.
member:Service.label: Service [Member]

member:ServiceAgreements.doc: Limited duration contract between, for example, an electricity transmission customer and an electricity transmission provider for service.
member:ServiceAgreements.label: Service Agreements [Member]

member:ServiceLife.doc: A revision in the estimated economic useful life of a long-lived tangible asset (the period of time over which the asset is projected to benefit operations).
member:ServiceLife.label: Service Life [Member]

member:ServiceOther.doc: Assistance, including, but not limited to, technology, license and maintenance, license and service, maintenance, oil and gas, financial service, and other financial service, classified as other.
member:ServiceOther.label: Service, Other [Member]

member:ServicingContracts.doc: Contracts to service financial assets including, but not limited to, credit cards and mortgages.
member:ServicingContracts.label: Servicing Contracts [Member]

member:SettledLitigation.doc: Agreement reached between parties in a litigation that occurs without judicial intervention, supervision or approval.
member:SettledLitigation.label: Settled Litigation [Member]

member:Short.doc: Indicates the sale of a borrowed security or written option.
member:Short.label: Short [Member]

member:ShortTermDebt.doc: Debt arrangement having an initial term within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
member:ShortTermDebt.label: Short-Term Debt [Member]

member:ShortTermInvestments.doc: Investments which are not otherwise included in another category or item that the entity has the intent to sell or dispose of within one year from the date of the balance sheet.
member:ShortTermInvestments.label: Short-Term Investments [Member]

member:SoftwareAndSoftwareDevelopmentCos.doc: Purchased software applications and internally developed software for sale, licensing or long-term internal use.
member:SoftwareAndSoftwareDevelopmentCos.label: Software and Software Development Costs [Member]

member:SoftwareDevelopment.doc: Internally developed software for sale, licensing or long-term internal use.
member:SoftwareDevelopment.label: Software Development [Member]

member:SoftwareInternallyDevelopedAndPur.doc: Internally developed and purchased software. Excludes in-development software.

member:SoutheastRegion.doc: Region of United States of America (US) designated as Southeast.
