member:SoutheastRegion.label: US Southeast Region [Member]

member:SouthwestRegion.doc: Region of United States of America (US) designated as Southwest.
member:SouthwestRegion.label: US Southwest Region [Member]

member:SovereignDebt.doc: Debt securities that are issued or guaranteed by a national government.

member:SovereignDebtSecurities.doc: Debt security issued by foreign government (not within the country of domicile of the entity).
member:SovereignDebtSecurities.label: Sovereign Debt Securities [Member]

member:SpecialMention.doc: A category of financing receivables considered to have potential weaknesses that deserve management's close attention. If left uncorrected, those potential weaknesses may result in a deterioration of the repayment prospects for the asset or of the creditor's position at some future date.
member:SpecialMention.label: Special Mention [Member]

member:Spinoff.doc: Creation of an independent entity from an existing entity through divestiture, for example, but not limited to, sale or distribution of new shares.

member:StandbyLettersOfCredit.doc: An irrevocable undertaking (typically by a financial institution) to guarantee payment of a specified financial obligation.
member:StandbyLettersOfCredit.label: Standby Letters of Credit [Member]

member:StateAndLocalJurisdiction.doc: Designated state or local jurisdiction entitled to levy and collect income tax.
member:StateAndLocalJurisdiction.label: State and Local Jurisdiction [Member]

member:SteamPlant.doc: Plant used in connection with steam-power generation of electricity.

member:StockCompensationPlan.doc: Share-based payment arrangement in which award of equity shares are granted. Arrangement includes, but is not limited to, grantor incurring liability for product and service based on price of its shares.
member:StockCompensationPlan.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement [Member]

member:StockOption.doc: Contracts conveying rights, but not obligations, to buy or sell a specific quantity of stock at a specified price during a specified period (an American option) or at a specified date (a European option).
member:StockOption.label: Equity Option [Member]

member:StockholdersEquityTotal.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of total stockholders' equity, when it serves as a benchmark in a concentration of risk calculation. Also called Net Assets.
member:StockholdersEquityTotal.label: Stockholders' Equity, Total [Member]

member:StormCosts.doc: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of costs for expected future uninsured storm damage.
member:StormCosts.label: Storm Costs [Member]

member:StructuredFinance.doc: This category includes information about generally complex financial arrangement used to help transfer risk, also referred to as structured debt.

member:StructuredSettlementAnnuity.doc: Contract providing periodic payments to a policyholder as agreed in settlement of a lawsuit.

member:SubordinatedDebt.doc: This element represents domestic or foreign subordinated debt. Subordinated debt has a lower priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.
member:SubordinatedDebt.label: Subordinated Debt [Member]

member:SubscriptionAndCirculation.doc: Right to receive or access periodic material for specified period of time.
member:SubscriptionAndCirculation.label: Subscription and Circulation [Member]

member:SubsequentEvent.doc: Identifies event that occurred after the balance sheet date but before financial statements are issued or available to be issued.
member:SubsequentEvent.label: Subsequent Event [Member]

member:Subsidiaries.doc: Entity in which controlling financial interest is held. Includes, but is not limited to, variable interest entity (VIE) consolidated by primary beneficiary. Excludes entity in which broker-dealer holds controlling financial interest but control is likely to be temporary.
member:Subsidiaries.label: Subsidiaries [Member]

member:SubsidiaryIssuer.doc: Entity in which controlling financial interest is held guaranteeing issuance of security by another subsidiary or parent. Includes, but is not limited to, variable interest entity (VIE) consolidated by primary beneficiary. Excludes entity in which broker-dealer holds controlling financial interest but control is likely to be temporary.
member:SubsidiaryIssuer.label: Subsidiary Issuer [Member]

member:SubsidiaryOfCommonParent.doc: Refers to an entity under the control of the same parent as another entity (that is, a sister company).
member:SubsidiaryOfCommonParent.label: Subsidiary of Common Parent [Member]

member:Substandard.doc: A category of financing receivables that are inadequately protected by the current sound worth and paying capacity of the obligor or of the collateral pledged, if any. Loans so classified have a well-defined weakness or weaknesses that jeopardize the liquidation of the debt. They are characterized by the distinct possibility that the creditor will sustain some loss if the deficiencies are not corrected.
member:Substandard.label: Substandard [Member]

member:SupplementalEmployeeRetirementPla.doc: Plan designed to provide limited group of employees with supplemental retirement benefits, in addition to other pension benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.
member:SupplementalEmployeeRetirementPla.label: Supplemental Employee Retirement Plan [Member]

member:TechnologyBasedIntangibleAssets.doc: Technology-based intangible assets, including, but not limited to, patented technology, unpatented technology, and developed technology rights.
member:TechnologyBasedIntangibleAssets.label: Technology-Based Intangible Assets [Member]

member:TechnologyEquipment.doc: Equipment used in the creation, maintenance and utilization of information systems which include computers and peripherals.
member:TechnologyEquipment.label: Technology Equipment [Member]

member:TechnologySector.doc: Sector of the economy consisting of companies engaged in technology-related business activities.
member:TechnologySector.label: Technology Sector [Member]

member:TechnologyService.doc: Technology assistance, including but not limited to, training, installation, engineering, and software design.
member:TechnologyService.label: Technology Service [Member]

member:TermLifeInsurance.doc: Contract providing death benefit payment in event of death within period specified in contract.
member:TermLifeInsurance.label: Term Life Insurance [Member]

member:TimeAndMaterialsContract.doc: Contract with customer in which amount of consideration is based on time and materials consumed.
member:TimeAndMaterialsContract.label: Time-and-Materials Contract [Member]

member:TotalReturnSwap.doc: Contracts in which one party makes payments at a fixed or variable rate while the counterparty makes payments based on an asset, including the income and capital gains derived therefrom.
member:TotalReturnSwap.label: Total Return Swap [Member]

member:TradeAccountsReceivable.doc: Amount due from customers or clients for goods or services that have been delivered or sold in the normal course of business.
member:TradeAccountsReceivable.label: Trade Accounts Receivable [Member]

member:TradeNames.doc: Rights acquired through registration of a business name to gain or protect exclusive use thereof.
member:TradeNames.label: Trade Names [Member]

member:Trademarks.doc: Rights acquired through registration of a trademark to gain or protect exclusive use of a business name, symbol or other device or style.
member:Trademarks.label: Trademarks [Member]

member:TrademarksAndTradeNames.doc: Rights acquired through registration of a trademark to gain or protect exclusive use of a business name, symbol or other device or style, or rights either acquired through registration of a business name to gain or protect exclusive use thereof.
member:TrademarksAndTradeNames.label: Trademarks and Trade Names [Member]

member:TradingAssetsExcludingDebtAndEqui.doc: Investments which the entity trades for its own profit, which may include, but is not limited to, mortgage-backed and asset-backed securities, loans, interest rate swaps, credit derivatives, commodity contracts, foreign exchange contracts and equity swaps. Excludes debt and equity securities.

member:TransferredAtPointInTime.doc: Contract with customer in which good or service is transferred at point in time.
member:TransferredAtPointInTime.label: Transferred at Point in Time [Member]

member:TransferredOverTime.doc: Contract with customer in which good or service is transferred over time.
member:TransferredOverTime.label: Transferred over Time [Member]

member:TreasuryLock.doc: Customized agreement that fixes the yield or price on a specified treasury security for a specific period.
member:TreasuryLock.label: Treasury Lock [Member]

member:TreasuryStockCommon.doc: Previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.
member:TreasuryStockCommon.label: Treasury Stock, Common [Member]

member:TrustForBenefitOfEmployees.doc: Trust created by the entity that exists for the benefit of its employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management.

member:TrustPreferredSecuritiesSubjectTo.doc: Preferred securities that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) or upon an event that is certain to occur, that are issued by a consolidated trust to outside investors where the trust uses the proceeds of the issuance of those securities to purchase, from the financial institution that established the trust, an equivalent amount of junior subordinated debentures or other loans having stated maturities.
member:TrustPreferredSecuritiesSubjectTo.label: Trust Preferred Securities Subject to Mandatory Redemption [Member]

member:USGovernmentAgenciesDebtSecuritie.doc: Debentures, notes, and other debt securities issued by US government agencies, for example, but not limited to, Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA or Ginnie Mae). Excludes US treasury securities and debt issued by government-sponsored Enterprises (GSEs), for example, but is not limited to, Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC or Freddie Mac), Federal National Mortgage Association (FNMA or Fannie Mae), and the Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB).
member:USGovernmentAgenciesDebtSecuritie.label: US Government Agencies Debt Securities [Member]

member:USGovernmentCorporationsAndAgenci.doc: This category includes information about debt issued by US Government Corporations and Agencies. Investments in such US Government Corporations may include debt securities issued by the Government National Mortgage Association (Ginnie Mae) and by the Federal National Mortgage Association (Fannie Mae) and the Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (Freddie Mac).
member:USGovernmentCorporationsAndAgenci.label: US Government Corporations and Agencies Securities [Member]

member:USGovernmentDebtSecurities.doc: Debt securities issued by the United States government.
member:USGovernmentDebtSecurities.label: US Government Debt Securities [Member]

member:USGovernmentSponsoredEnterprisesD.doc: Debentures, bonds and other debt securities issued by US government sponsored entities (GSEs), for example, but not limited to, Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC or Freddie Mac), Federal National Mortgage Association (FNMA or Fannie Mae), and the Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB). Excludes debt issued by the Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA or Ginnie Mae).
member:USGovernmentSponsoredEnterprisesD.label: US Government-sponsored Enterprises Debt Securities [Member]

member:USStatesAndPoliticalSubdivisions.doc: Bonds or similar securities issued by state, city, or local US governments or the agencies operated by state, city, or local governments. Debt securities issued by state governments may include bond issuances of US state authorities including, for example, but not limited to, housing authorities, dormitory authorities, and general obligations while debt securities issued by political subdivisions of US states would include, for example, debt issuances by county, borough, city, or municipal governments.
member:USStatesAndPoliticalSubdivisions.label: US States and Political Subdivisions Debt Securities [Member]

member:USTreasuryAndGovernment.doc: This category includes investments in debt securities issued by the United States Department of the Treasury, US Government Agencies and US Government-sponsored Enterprises. Such securities may include treasury bills (short-term maturities - one year or less), treasury notes (intermediate term maturities - two to ten years), and treasury bonds (long-term maturities - ten to thirty years), debt securities issued by the Government National Mortgage Association (Ginnie Mae) and debt securities issued by the Federal National Mortgage Association (Fannie Mae) or the Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (Freddie Mac).
member:USTreasuryAndGovernment.label: US Treasury and Government [Member]

member:USTreasuryBillSecurities.doc: This category includes information about negotiable debt securities issued by the United States Department of the Treasury which generally have maturities of one year or less, are interest bearing, and are backed by the full faith and credit of the United States government.
member:USTreasuryBillSecurities.label: US Treasury Bill Securities [Member]

member:USTreasuryNotesSecurities.doc: This category includes information about negotiable debt securities issued by the United States Department of the Treasury which generally have maturities of one to ten years, are interest bearing, and are backed by the full faith and credit of the United States government.
member:USTreasuryNotesSecurities.label: US Treasury Notes Securities [Member]

member:USTreasurySecurities.doc: This category includes information about debt securities issued by the United States Department of the Treasury and backed by the United States government. Such securities primarily consist of treasury bills (short-term maturities - one year or less), treasury notes (intermediate term maturities - two to ten years), and treasury bonds (long-term maturities - ten to thirty years).
member:USTreasurySecurities.label: US Treasury Securities [Member]

member:UnallocatedFinancingReceivables.doc: Financing receivables that have not been allocated to a portfolio segment.
member:UnallocatedFinancingReceivables.label: Unallocated Financing Receivables [Member]

member:UnbilledRevenues.doc: Unbilled amounts due for services rendered or products shipped. This element is distinct from unbilled contracts receivables because this is based on noncontract transactions.
member:UnbilledRevenues.label: Unbilled Revenues [Member]

member:Uncollateralized.doc: No pledge of specific property to serve as protection or security against default.
member:Uncollateralized.label: Uncollateralized [Member]

member:UnfundedLoanCommitment.doc: Undisbursed funds of a credit facility in which the borrower may draw upon.
member:UnfundedLoanCommitment.label: Unfunded Loan Commitment [Member]

member:UniversalLife.doc: Life insurance contract under which premiums are generally flexible, the level of death benefits may be adjusted, and mortality expense, and other charges may vary.

member:UnlikelyToBeCollectedFinancingRec.doc: Financing arrangement that represents a contractual right to receive money either on demand or on fixed or determinable dates that are considered uncollectible or of little value. Excludes no recovery or salvage value.
member:UnlikelyToBeCollectedFinancingRec.label: Unlikely to be Collected Financing Receivable [Member]

member:UnregulatedOperation.doc: Operation of entity not regulated by governmental or other regulatory organizations.

member:UnsecuredDebt.doc: Debt obligation not collateralized by pledge of, mortgage of or other lien on the entity's assets.
member:UnsecuredDebt.label: Unsecured Debt [Member]

member:UsGovernmentAgencyInsuredLoans.doc: Guarantee by US government agencies, including but not limited to, Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA) and Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) for government insured loans.
member:UsGovernmentAgencyInsuredLoans.label: US Government Agency Insured Loans [Member]

member:UsGovernmentSponsoredEnterpriseIn.doc: Guarantee by US government-sponsored enterprises, including but not limited to, Federal National Mortgage Association (FNMA) or Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC) for government insured loans.
member:UsGovernmentSponsoredEnterpriseIn.label: US Government Sponsored-Enterprise Insured Loans [Member]

member:ValuationTechniqueConsensusPricin.doc: Valuation technique combining analyst price estimates.
member:ValuationTechniqueConsensusPricin.label: Valuation Technique, Consensus Pricing Model [Member]

member:ValuationTechniqueDiscountedCashF.doc: Valuation technique calculating present value of future cash flows.
member:ValuationTechniqueDiscountedCashF.label: Valuation Technique, Discounted Cash Flow [Member]

member:VariableAnnuity.doc: Contract providing periodic payment that varies according to investment experience of separate account in which amount paid to provide for annuity is allocated.

member:VariableInterestEntityNotPrimaryB.doc: Variable Interest Entities (VIE) in which the entity does not have a controlling financial interest (as defined) and of which it is therefore not the primary beneficiary. VIEs of which the entity is not the primary beneficiary because it does not have the power to direct the activities of the VIE that most significantly impact the VIE's economic performance and for which it does not have the obligation to absorb losses of the VIE that could potentially be significant to the VIE or the right to receive benefits from the VIE that could potentially be significant to the VIE are not included in the consolidated financial statements of the entity.
member:VariableInterestEntityNotPrimaryB.label: Variable Interest Entity, Not Primary Beneficiary [Member]

member:VariableInterestEntityPrimaryBene.doc: Variable Interest Entities (VIE) in which the entity has a controlling financial interest (as defined) and of which it is therefore the primary beneficiary. A controlling financial interest is determined based on both: (a) the entity's power to direct activities of the VIE that most significantly impact the VIE's economic performance and (b) the entity's obligation to absorb losses of the VIE that could potentially be significant to the VIE or the right to receive benefits from the VIE that could potentially be significant to the VIE. VIEs of which the entity is the primary beneficiary are included in the consolidated financial statements of the entity.
member:VariableInterestEntityPrimaryBene.label: Variable Interest Entity, Primary Beneficiary [Member]

member:VariableLife.doc: Contract providing life insurance under which benefit payable upon death or surrender varies to reflect investment experience of separate account supporting policy.
member:VariableLife.label: Variable Life [Member]

member:VariableUniversalLife.doc: Contract providing life insurance that combines both adjustability of premium, coverage and investment features, and variability of benefit payable upon death or surrender from investment experience of separate account supporting contract.
